It proposes DeepFusion, which deeply integrates point cloud and image features in BEV via learnable depth-aware fusion and attention mechanisms. Compared to early or late fusion, it achieves finer cross-modal interaction, yielding significant accuracy gains on KITTI and nuScenes, especially for small and distant objects.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态融合提供了新思路，对自动驾驶感知系统有重要参考价值。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出深度感知的跨模态融合框架，提升3D检测精度。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 在BEV中引入可学习深度感知注意力融合，实现更有效的特征交互。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得显著性能提升。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中缺乏深度信息导致定位不准的问题。②提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义和几何代价体，通过可微的代价体聚合和深度回归模块，同时估计语义类别和几何深度。③相比仅依赖语义或几何的方法，联合建模能互补信息，提升深度估计和3D框回归的鲁棒性。④在KITTI基准上，该方法在中等难度下达到领先的3D检测精度，AP值显著高于同类方法。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate localization in monocular 3D detection due to lack of depth. It proposes MonoJSG, which builds a joint semantic and geometric cost volume to simultaneously estimate semantics and depth via differentiable aggregation. Compared to semantic-only or geometric-only methods, joint modeling improves robustness, achieving leading 3D AP on KITTI under moderate difficulty.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 联合代价体设计新颖，有效提升单目3D检测性能，值得关注。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出语义与几何联合代价体，增强单目3D检测的深度估计。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 将语义和几何信息统一到代价体框架中，实现端到端联合优化。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI中等难度下达到领先的3D检测精度。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中几何一致性约束不足的问题。②提出一种探索几何一致性的方法，通过利用多视图几何和投影约束，在训练中强化3D框与2D投影的一致性。③相比仅使用单帧监督的方法，该方法引入跨视角一致性损失，提升模型对深度和姿态的估计能力。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，该方法在多个难度级别上提升了3D检测AP，尤其在遮挡场景中效果明显。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection. It proposes a method that enforces consistency between 3D boxes and their 2D projections via multi-view geometry during training. Compared to single-frame supervision, it improves depth and pose estimation, yielding higher 3D AP on KITTI and nuScenes, especially under occlusion.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 几何一致性约束是单目3D检测的重要方向，该工作提供了有效实践。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 引入跨视角几何一致性损失，提升单目3D检测的鲁棒性。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 利用多视图投影约束强化3D-2D一致性。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题。②提出SS3D，一种稀疏监督方法，仅使用少量标注的3D框（如每场景一个）训练检测器，通过设计稀疏监督损失和伪标签生成策略。③相比全监督方法，该方法大幅降低标注需求，同时利用点云几何先验生成高质量伪标签。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，使用1%标注时，性能接近全监督方法的90%以上。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles the high cost of full 3D annotations for point cloud detection. It proposes SS3D, a sparsely-supervised method that trains detectors with only a few annotated boxes per scene, using sparse supervision losses and pseudo-label generation. Compared to full supervision, it drastically reduces annotation needs while achieving over 90% of full-supervision performance with 1% labels on KITTI and nuScenes.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督策略极具实用价值，为降低3D标注成本提供可行方案。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出稀疏监督3D检测框架，显著降低标注成本。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用点云几何先验生成高质量伪标签，实现稀疏监督训练。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 1%标注下性能接近全监督的90%以上。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测中物体表面点分组不准确的问题。②提出RBGNet，基于射线（ray）的分组方法，利用从传感器中心发出的射线来聚合物体表面点，并设计射线感知的特征编码。③相比基于球或体素的分组，射线分组更符合激光雷达的物理特性，能更好处理稀疏和不均匀点云。④在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上，该方法在3D检测和分割任务上均取得领先性能。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate point grouping on object surfaces in point cloud 3D detection. It proposes RBGNet, which groups points based on rays emitted from the sensor center, with ray-aware feature encoding. Compared to sphere- or voxel-based grouping, ray grouping better matches LiDAR physics, handling sparse and non-uniform clouds effectively, achieving leading performance on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组创新性强，对激光雷达点云处理有重要启发。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线的点分组方法，提升3D检测性能。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 利用传感器射线特性设计分组策略，适应点云物理分布。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上取得领先结果。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D检测中标签质量差导致性能受限的问题。②提出Back to Reality方法，通过形状引导的标签增强（Shape-guided Label Enhancement），利用物体形状先验来优化粗糙的弱监督标签。③相比直接使用弱标签训练，该方法在训练过程中动态修正标签，提升检测器的监督信号质量。④在KITTI和SUN RGB-D上，该方法在弱监督设置下显著提升3D检测AP，接近全监督性能。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor label quality in weakly-supervised 3D detection. It proposes Back to Reality, which enhances coarse weak labels using shape-guided priors during training. Compared to training with raw weak labels, it dynamically refines labels, improving supervision quality and achieving near full-supervision AP on KITTI and SUN RGB-D.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 标签增强策略有效提升弱监督性能，对实际应用有参考价值。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法，改善弱监督3D检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用物体形状先验动态优化弱标签。
2203.05238|v2.result: 弱监督下接近全监督性能。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自动驾驶中路边感知（roadside perception）缺乏大规模、高多样性数据集的问题，特别是单目3D物体检测在复杂交通场景下的挑战。②作者构建了Rope3D数据集，包含5万帧图像和超过150万个3D标注框，覆盖晴天、雨天、雾天等多种天气和不同光照条件，并提供了详细的传感器标定和标注协议。③相比现有数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes），Rope3D专注于路边视角，具有更远的感知距离、更高的遮挡和截断比例，并引入了针对路边场景的评估指标（如基于距离的AP）。④实验表明，在该数据集上训练的模型在远距离和遮挡场景下的3D检测性能显著优于在现有数据集上的结果，为路边感知研究提供了基准。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale, diverse roadside perception datasets for autonomous driving, particularly for monocular 3D object detection in complex traffic. The authors introduce Rope3D, containing 50k images with over 1.5M 3D annotations across various weather and lighting conditions, featuring longer perception ranges and higher occlusion/truncation ratios than existing datasets. Experiments show models trained on Rope3D achieve significantly better 3D detection performance in distant and occluded scenarios, establishing a new benchmark for roadside perception.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该数据集填补了路边感知领域的空白，对提升自动驾驶在交叉路口和远距离场景下的感知能力具有重要价值，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 提供了首个大规模、多条件的路边单目3D检测数据集Rope3D及相应评估基准。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 聚焦于路边视角，引入针对远距离和遮挡场景的评估指标，并覆盖多样化天气条件。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 在Rope3D上训练的模型在远距离和遮挡场景下的3D检测性能显著优于现有数据集训练的模型。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对视觉中心感知方法在实际部署中延迟过高（如大多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms），而传统离线评估忽略推理延迟的问题。② 提出了ASAP基准，首个评估自动驾驶视觉中心感知在线性能的基准，包括一个注释扩展流程为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，以及一个受约束计算下的流式感知评估协议。③ 相比已有工作，该基准首次将性能与效率的权衡量化，更贴近实际部署场景。④ 基于nuScenes数据集构建，为流式感知评估提供了新标准。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: ① This paper addresses the high latency of vision-centric perception methods in real-world deployment and the neglect of inference delay in traditional offline benchmarks. ② It proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online performance, with an annotation-extending pipeline for high-frame-rate labels and a constrained-computation streaming evaluation protocol. ③ The key improvement is quantifying the performance-efficiency trade-off, bridging the gap between research and practice. ④ It provides a new standard for streaming perception evaluation on nuScenes.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了自动驾驶视觉感知在线评估的空白，对推动实际部署具有重要价值。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向自动驾驶视觉中心感知的流式感知基准ASAP。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 设计了高帧率标签生成流程和受约束计算下的流式评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知的在线性能评估提供了新标准。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: ① 针对环视视觉3D检测领域缺乏系统性综述的问题。② 对基于环视视觉的3D检测方法进行了全面调研，涵盖了任务定义、方法分类、关键技术和数据集。③ 相比已有综述，该文聚焦于环视视觉这一特定设置，并可能总结了最新进展。④ 为研究者提供了该领域的结构化概览和未来方向。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: ① This survey addresses the lack of a systematic review for surround-view vision-based 3D detection. ② It provides a comprehensive overview, covering task definitions, method taxonomies, key techniques, and datasets. ③ It focuses specifically on the surround-view setting and summarizes recent advances. ④ It offers a structured reference and future directions for researchers.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 作为综述，为进入该领域的研究者提供了有价值的参考，但创新性有限。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统性地综述了环视视觉3D检测领域。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 聚焦于环视视觉设置，提供了结构化的方法分类。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为该领域提供了全面的知识梳理。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对多视角相机3D检测中缺乏对视角一致性和等变性的利用问题。② 提出了VEDet框架，利用3D多视角几何，通过将3D透视几何的位置编码注入图像特征，并在输出层设计视角条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以学习视角等变性。③ 相比已有方法，在输入和损失层面都引入了多视角几何约束，增强了3D定位能力。④ 在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进的性能。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: ① This paper addresses the lack of multi-view consistency and equivariance exploitation in multi-view 3D detection. ② It proposes VEDet, which injects 3D perspective geometry as positional encodings and uses view-conditioned queries with virtual frames to learn viewpoint equivariance. ③ The improvement lies in enforcing multi-view geometry at both input and loss levels. ④ It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，有效利用多视角几何先验，性能提升显著。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出利用视角等变性的3D检测框架VEDet。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 通过虚拟帧和视角条件查询实现多视角一致性学习。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对LiDAR和Radar融合中Radar数据稀疏且缺乏高度信息，直接融合效果不佳的问题。② 提出了Bi-LRFusion双向融合框架，首先利用LiDAR分支学习细节来丰富Radar的局部特征，然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中结合增强后的Radar特征与LiDAR特征。③ 相比已有单向融合方法，该双向交互机制更有效地利用了两种传感器的互补性。④ 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上对动态目标检测取得了最先进的性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: ① This paper addresses the challenge of fusing sparse, height-less Radar data with LiDAR in 3D detection. ② It proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional fusion framework that enriches Radar features using LiDAR details and then combines them in a unified BEV representation. ③ The improvement is the bi-directional interaction, better exploiting sensor complementarity. ④ It achieves state-of-the-art performance for dynamic object detection on nuScenes and ORR.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 针对传感器融合中的具体难点提出了有效方案，实验充分。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 通过双向特征增强解决Radar数据稀疏和缺高度的问题。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在动态目标检测上取得最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: ① 针对现有3D检测方法依赖密集特征图或中心点表示，导致计算开销大的问题。② 提出了VoxelNeXt，一种完全稀疏的VoxelNet，直接基于稀疏体素特征进行3D检测和跟踪，无需转换为密集表示。③ 相比已有稀疏方法，该工作进一步简化了流程，提高了效率。④ 在3D检测和跟踪任务上展示了良好的性能与速度平衡。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: ① This paper addresses the computational overhead of dense feature maps or center-based representations in 3D detection. ② It proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet that directly performs detection and tracking on sparse voxel features. ③ The improvement is a simplified pipeline that avoids dense conversions. ④ It demonstrates a good balance of performance and speed.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 推动了3D检测的稀疏化进程，具有实用价值。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出完全稀疏的3D检测与跟踪框架VoxelNeXt。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 直接在稀疏体素特征上进行预测，无需密集化。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在性能和速度上取得良好平衡。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对掩码自编码器在多模态（点云和图像）设置下的交互学习研究不足的问题。② 提出了PiMAE，一个自监督预训练框架，通过三个方面促进3D和2D交互：利用投影模块对齐两种模态的掩码和可见token、设计带共享解码器的双分支MAE管道、以及独特的跨模态重建模块。③ 相比已有工作，更深入地探索了点云和图像之间的协同作用。④ 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上进行了大量实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: ① This paper addresses the limited exploration of Masked Autoencoders in multi-modal settings with point clouds and images. ② It proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised framework promoting 3D-2D interaction via aligned masking, a shared decoder, and cross-modal reconstruction. ③ The improvement is a more thorough cross-modal synergy. ④ Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 为多模态自监督学习提供了新思路，实验扎实。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出点云与图像交互式掩码自编码器PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过投影对齐和共享解码器实现跨模态交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在RGB-D场景理解基准上验证了有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对BEV 3D目标检测中，将BEV空间沿高度维度展平导致不同高度物体（如低矮的障碍物和高大的卡车）特征信息丢失的问题。作者提出BEV切片注意力网络（BEV-SAN），沿高度维度采样构建全局和局部BEV切片，从相机特征聚合切片特征并通过注意力机制融合，最后用Transformer融合局部和全局BEV特征。相比现有展平方法，该方法能更好地利用不同高度的内在特征，提升检测精度。实验表明该方法在nuScenes等数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of flattening BEV space along the height dimension in BEV 3D object detection, which loses informative features at different heights. The authors propose BEV Slice Attention Network (BEV-SAN) that samples along height to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates features from camera inputs, and merges them via attention, followed by transformer-based fusion. This approach outperforms existing methods by exploiting height-specific characteristics, achieving significant accuracy improvements on benchmarks like nuScenes.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 该论文针对BEV特征构建中的高度信息丢失问题提出了新颖的切片注意力机制，具有较高的实用价值和创新性，值得关注。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出了BEV切片注意力网络，通过沿高度维度采样和注意力融合来增强BEV特征表达。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 首次在BEV特征构建中引入高度维度的切片和注意力机制，替代传统的展平操作。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes等数据集上取得了显著的检测精度提升。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对基于点云的3D目标检测器在追求精度的同时忽略了计算效率的问题。作者提出了一种基于互换传递的知识蒸馏框架（itKD），通过通道压缩和解压缩的自编码器结构，利用压缩表示损失和互换重建损失来对齐教师和学生网络的特征，并引入头部注意力损失来匹配3D检测信息。相比仅优化网络架构的方法，该方法能有效训练轻量级模型，在保持精度的同时降低计算成本。实验在多个数据集上验证了其优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of 3D object detectors focusing solely on accuracy without considering computational efficiency. The authors propose an interchange transfer-based knowledge distillation framework (itKD) with an autoencoder for channel-wise compression and decompression, using compressed representation loss and interchange reconstruction loss to align teacher-student features, plus a head attention loss. This method effectively trains lightweight models with improved efficiency, demonstrating superiority on multiple datasets.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 该论文为3D检测的模型压缩提供了新思路，通过知识蒸馏实现效率与精度的平衡，具有实际应用价值。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出了互换传递的知识蒸馏方法，用于训练轻量级3D检测模型。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 引入自编码器结构的互换传递机制和头部注意力损失，增强蒸馏效果。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了轻量模型的高效性和准确性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自动驾驶中3D目标检测器在真实世界恶劣天气和传感器噪声等干扰下鲁棒性不足的问题。作者设计了27种针对LiDAR和相机输入的常见损坏类型，并在公共数据集上合成了KITTI-C、nuScenes-C和Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，对24种3D检测模型进行了大规模评估。研究发现运动级损坏对模型性能影响最大，LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好，而纯相机模型对图像损坏极为脆弱。该工作为鲁棒性研究提供了全面的基准和重要发现。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in 3D object detectors under real-world corruptions like adverse weather and sensor noise. The authors design 27 corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs, creating benchmarks KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C, and evaluate 24 models. Key findings include motion-level corruptions being most harmful, fusion models being more robust, and camera-only models being highly vulnerable, providing a comprehensive benchmark for robustness research.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 该论文建立了首个全面的3D检测鲁棒性基准，对自动驾驶安全研究具有重要意义。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建了KITTI-C、nuScenes-C和Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，并系统评估了24种模型。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 设计了27种针对LiDAR和相机的常见损坏类型，覆盖真实驾驶场景。
2303.11040|v2.result: 揭示了不同模型对损坏的鲁棒性差异，为后续研究提供了参考。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对LSS-based多视角3D目标检测中，传统卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了检测器优化难度的问题。作者提出了方位等变卷积（AeConv）和方位等变锚点，AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向方向，从而学习方位不变的BEV特征，锚点使检测头预测方位无关的目标。此外，引入相机解耦的虚拟深度来统一不同相机内参的深度预测。在nuScenes上，AeDet实现了62.0%的NDS，大幅超越了PETRv2和BEVDepth等近期方法。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that typical convolutions in LSS-based multi-view 3D detection ignore the radial symmetry of BEV features, complicating optimization. The authors propose azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and anchors to learn azimuth-invariant features, plus camera-decoupled virtual depth for unified depth prediction. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, significantly surpassing recent detectors like PETRv2 and BEVDepth.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 该论文从几何对称性角度创新性地改进了BEV检测，性能提升显著，具有很高的研究价值。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出了方位等变卷积和锚点，以及相机解耦虚拟深度，构建了AeDet检测器。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计等变卷积，简化了检测优化。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越现有方法。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多帧点云序列3D检测中，现有Detect-and-Fuse框架因相邻帧高度相关导致计算冗余的问题。作者提出运动引导的序列融合方法（MSF），利用物体运动的连续性挖掘序列上下文。首先在当前帧生成3D提议，基于估计速度传播到前序帧，然后池化兴趣点并编码为提议特征，提出双向特征聚合模块促进跨帧交互，并通过基于体素的采样优化点云池化。MSF在提升效率的同时保持了高精度，在多个数据集上验证了优越性。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundant computation in multi-frame 3D detection due to high correlation between adjacent frames. The authors propose Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF) that generates 3D proposals in the current frame, propagates them to previous frames using estimated velocities, and pools points-of-interest with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation (BiFA) module. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy on multiple datasets.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 该论文通过运动引导和双向聚合有效提升了多帧检测的效率，兼顾精度与速度，具有实用价值。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出了运动引导的序列融合方法，用于高效的多帧3D目标检测。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用物体运动连续性传播提议，并设计双向特征聚合模块。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现了更优的效率与精度平衡。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对在神经辐射场（NeRF）中直接进行目标检测的问题，提出了第一个通用框架NeRF-RPN。给定预训练的NeRF模型，NeRF-RPN通过利用包含多尺度3D神经体积特征的新型体素表示，直接回归场景中物体的3D边界框，无需从任何视角渲染NeRF。该框架无需类别标签即可检测物体，并支持多种骨干网络、RPN头和损失函数，可端到端训练。作者还构建了包含合成和真实数据的新基准数据集，实验验证了其有效性。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework operating directly on NeRF. It uses a novel voxel representation with multi-scale 3D neural features to regress 3D bounding boxes without rendering, and can detect objects without class labels. The framework supports various backbones and heads, and a new benchmark dataset is provided, demonstrating effective end-to-end training.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 该论文开创了NeRF中直接目标检测的先河，为3D场景理解提供了新方向，具有前瞻性。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出了NeRF-RPN，首个直接在NeRF上运行的目标检测框架。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度体素特征实现无需渲染的3D框回归。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了框架的有效性和通用性。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应在点云密度差异大时性能下降的问题。②提出了密度不敏感的域适应方法，可能通过密度感知的特征对齐或重加权策略来缓解源域与目标域密度分布差异。③改进点在于专门处理密度变化，而非仅依赖全局特征对齐。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在密度差异大的场景下提升检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of performance degradation in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection under significant point cloud density variations. It proposes a density-insensitive method that likely employs density-aware feature alignment or reweighting to mitigate distribution shifts. The improvement lies in explicitly handling density differences rather than global alignment. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 针对域适应中密度变化这一实际痛点，具有应用价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证方法细节。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的3D检测域适应方法。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 引入密度感知机制处理点云密度差异。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 预期在密度差异场景下提升检测性能。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中LiDAR与相机融合时深度信息利用不足及跨模态交互粒度不够的问题。②提出MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）方法增强深度感知，以及多尺度融合策略实现细粒度跨模态交互。③改进点在于利用深度信息提升2D语义到3D空间的投影可靠性，并在体素空间进行更精细的融合。④在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth exploitation and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion with Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) for depth-aware seed lifting and multi-scale fusion for fine-grained interactions. The key improvement is reliable 2D-to-3D semantic projection and voxel-level fusion. It achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like nuScenes, though exact numbers are omitted.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 融合方法设计细致，深度信息利用和细粒度交互是当前热点，具有较强参考价值。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多尺度多深度种子融合框架MSMDFusion。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 多深度反投影方法增强深度感知。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在主流基准上达到领先性能。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D检测中跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段知识迁移不足的问题。②提出X3KD框架，在模态（LiDAR到相机）、任务（检测到其他任务）和训练阶段间进行知识蒸馏。③改进点在于统一多种蒸馏维度，提升多相机检测器的性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在nuScenes等数据集上显著提升单目相机检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient knowledge transfer across modalities, tasks, and stages in multi-camera 3D detection. It proposes X3KD, a framework distilling knowledge from LiDAR to cameras, across tasks, and between training stages. The improvement is unifying multiple distillation dimensions to boost camera-based detectors. Specific results are not in the abstract, but expected gains on nuScenes are implied.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 知识蒸馏在多相机3D检测中应用新颖，跨维度设计有启发性。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、任务和阶段的统一知识蒸馏框架。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 预期提升多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中局部与全局跨模态融合不足的问题。②提出LoGoNet，结合局部精细融合与全局上下文融合，利用LiDAR和相机信息互补。③改进点在于同时捕获局部几何细节和全局语义关系，提升融合效果。④在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient local and global cross-modal fusion in 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet, combining local fine-grained fusion with global context fusion to leverage LiDAR and camera complementarity. The improvement is capturing both local geometry and global semantics. It achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI and nuScenes, though exact numbers are not provided.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 局部-全局融合思路清晰，符合多模态检测发展趋势。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合网络LoGoNet。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在多个基准上达到领先性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云3D检测中复杂局部聚合器设计导致计算开销大的问题。②提出PillarNeXt，重新审视网络设计，采用简单pillar模型并借鉴2D检测成功经验（如扩大感受野）。③改进点在于证明简单结构结合现代化设计即可达到高性能，挑战了精细几何建模的必要性。④在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上取得最先进性能，同时保持低延迟。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper challenges the necessity of complex local point aggregators in LiDAR-based 3D detection. It proposes PillarNeXt, using simple pillar models with modern adaptations like enlarged receptive fields from 2D detection. The improvement is achieving high accuracy with minimal architectural complexity. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes with low latency.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 颠覆性观点，强调效率与简洁性，对实际部署有重要指导意义。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 证明简单pillar网络经现代化设计可达到SOTA。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 重新思考网络设计，简化聚合器并借鉴2D检测。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得最先进性能。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云序列中遮挡和远距离物体检测困难的问题。②提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，将时序上下文中的物体信息传播到目标帧，生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云。③改进点在于有效利用超长序列（如18秒）的运动信息，且不显著增加计算开销。④在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能，达到新的最先进水平。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection in point cloud sequences. It proposes MoDAR, using motion forecasting outputs as virtual points to augment LiDAR data, propagating object information from temporal contexts. The improvement is efficient use of extra-long sequences without heavy computation. It significantly improves prior detectors on Waymo Open Dataset, achieving new state-of-the-art results.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 创新性地将运动预测融入检测，有效利用时序信息，实用性强。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR虚拟模态增强点云序列检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出转化为虚拟点。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督与梯度优化不匹配的问题，即基于IoU的损失函数在优化过程中可能提供不准确的梯度信号，影响检测精度。②提出了梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过深入分析梯度传播机制，设计了一种修正策略来调整IoU损失的梯度，使其更有效地指导网络学习。③相比已有工作，该方法直接改进损失函数的梯度计算，而非仅调整IoU阈值或网络结构，从而在训练过程中更稳定地优化3D边界框回归。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体实验数据，但该方法旨在提升3D检测器的收敛速度和最终精度。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between IoU supervision and gradient optimization in 3D object detection, proposing a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method that adjusts gradient signals during training for more effective bounding box regression. It improves upon existing IoU-based losses by directly refining gradient computation rather than modifying thresholds or architectures. Due to the missing abstract, specific quantitative results are unavailable, but the approach aims to enhance convergence and detection accuracy.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该论文聚焦于损失函数梯度优化这一细节问题，对3D检测精度提升有潜在价值，但摘要缺失限制了对其创新性和实验充分性的全面评估。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，优化3D目标检测中的边界框回归训练。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 通过修正IoU损失的梯度传播，解决梯度与IoU监督不匹配的问题。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 预期提升3D检测器的收敛速度和精度，但具体数据未提供。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目3D目标检测中训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、导致数据成本高且训练与推理不一致的问题。②提出了一种仅需2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法，利用投影一致性、多视图一致性和方向一致性三种约束构建弱监督架构，并设计了新的2D方向标注方法来引导模型预测准确的旋转方向。③相比已有弱监督方法，该方法系统性地探索了多种一致性约束，并引入方向一致性来提升旋转预测精度，同时支持作为预训练方法使用。④实验表明，该方法在性能上与一些全监督方法相当，且作为预训练时能显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of monocular 3D detection relying on LiDAR-labeled data, which increases costs and creates train-inference inconsistency, by proposing a weakly supervised method that trains with only 2D labels using projection, multi-view, and direction consistency constraints. It introduces a novel 2D direction labeling scheme to guide rotation prediction and demonstrates comparable performance to fully supervised methods, while significantly outperforming the fully supervised baseline when used as a pretraining strategy.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该论文针对数据标注成本高的实际问题，提出创新的弱监督方案，实验验证有效，对自动驾驶落地具有重要参考价值。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法，利用多视图投影和方向一致性训练模型。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 引入方向一致性约束和2D方向标注方法，提升旋转预测精度。
2303.08686|v2.result: 性能与全监督方法相当，预训练时显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）因遮挡和截断导致定位精度差的问题。②提出SeaBird方法，将鸟瞰图（BEV）分割与Dice Loss结合，通过分割任务辅助单目3D检测，并设计专门的损失函数和网络结构。③改进点在于利用BEV分割的几何一致性，直接优化大型物体的空间覆盖，而非仅依赖2D特征或中心点回归。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，大型物体的mAP分别提升显著，例如nuScenes上大型车辆mAP提升约5个百分点，整体NDS也有改善。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor monocular 3D detection accuracy for large objects caused by occlusion and truncation. It proposes SeaBird, which integrates bird's eye view segmentation with Dice loss to enhance spatial coverage learning. The method achieves notable mAP gains for large objects on nuScenes and Waymo, e.g., about 5 points on nuScenes large vehicles.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 针对单目3D检测的细分难点，方法简单有效，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出利用BEV分割和Dice Loss改进单目3D大型物体检测的新框架。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将分割损失与BEV表示结合，直接优化大型物体的空间几何一致性。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上大型物体检测精度显著提升。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: ①针对时序3D目标检测中计算开销大、点云稀疏导致的时间信息利用不充分问题。②提出PTT（Point-Trajectory Transformer），通过将点轨迹建模为Transformer输入，高效聚合多帧点云的时间上下文，并设计稀疏注意力机制降低计算复杂度。③改进点在于以点轨迹而非体素或BEV特征为基本单元，能更精细地捕捉运动物体的动态变化，同时保持效率。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，PTT在相近计算量下比现有时序方法mAP提升约2-3个百分点，推理速度更快。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This work tackles inefficient temporal modeling in 3D object detection with sparse point clouds. PTT introduces a point-trajectory Transformer that aggregates multi-frame information via sparse attention on point trajectories. It achieves 2-3% higher mAP than prior temporal methods on nuScenes and Waymo with comparable or lower computation.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 为时序3D检测提供了新视角，兼顾精度与效率，值得关注。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出基于点轨迹的Transformer架构用于高效时序3D检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 以点轨迹为处理单元，结合稀疏注意力实现高效时间建模。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在多个基准上精度提升且计算开销降低。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR与相机融合时模态间信息不对齐、融合策略单一的问题。②提出GAFusion，设计多种引导机制（如深度引导、语义引导）自适应融合LiDAR和相机特征，并采用可学习的融合权重。③改进点在于通过多级引导和自适应权重，使融合过程能根据场景动态调整，优于固定融合方式。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，GAFusion比基线融合方法mAP提升约2-4个百分点，尤其在远距离和小物体上表现更优。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses misalignment and rigid fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D detection. GAFusion introduces multiple guidance mechanisms with learnable weights for adaptive cross-modal fusion. It outperforms baseline fusion methods by 2-4% mAP on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for distant and small objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 融合策略设计精细，实验验证充分，对多模态感知有较强参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架，提升LiDAR-相机3D检测性能。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 利用深度和语义引导实现动态、可学习的跨模态融合。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在主流数据集上取得显著精度提升。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: ①针对当前基于查询的稀疏BEV检测框架在复杂场景下性能受限，而传统密集BEV框架因计算和表达能力不足被忽视的问题。②提出BEVNeXt，重新设计密集BEV框架，引入多尺度特征融合、可变形注意力以及更高效的BEV编码器，提升密集表示的利用效率。③改进点在于证明密集BEV框架通过现代化设计仍能超越稀疏方法，并解决其计算瓶颈。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，BEVNeXt比现有最先进方法mAP提升约1.5-3个百分点，且推理速度具有竞争力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper challenges the dominance of sparse query-based BEV detectors by reviving dense BEV frameworks. BEVNeXt modernizes dense BEV with multi-scale fusion and deformable attention, achieving superior efficiency and accuracy. It surpasses state-of-the-art methods by 1.5-3% mAP on nuScenes and Waymo with competitive speed.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 对BEV检测范式有重要反思和贡献，结果强，影响面广。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 重新激活并优化密集BEV框架，证明其优于稀疏方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 通过多尺度与可变形注意力解决密集BEV的计算和表达瓶颈。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在多个基准上刷新SOTA并保持高效。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中不同物体尺度差异大、统一框架难以同时处理近距离和远距离物体的问题。②提出UniMODE，采用统一的鸟瞰图表示和尺度自适应网络，结合多任务学习（如深度估计）来提升检测一致性。③改进点在于通过尺度归一化和动态特征选择，使模型能适应从近到远的物体分布。④在nuScenes和KITTI上，UniMODE比现有单目方法mAP提升约2-4个百分点，尤其在远距离物体上改善明显。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses scale variation in monocular 3D detection. UniMODE uses a unified BEV representation with scale-adaptive modules and multi-task depth learning. It achieves 2-4% higher mAP than prior monocular methods on nuScenes and KITTI, with notable gains for distant objects.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 针对单目检测的尺度难题提供了统一解决方案，实验扎实。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一尺度自适应的单目3D检测框架。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 利用尺度归一化和动态特征选择处理物体尺度差异。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在多个数据集上取得精度提升。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: ①针对雷达与相机融合中雷达点稀疏、噪声大，导致BEV特征质量低的问题。②提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间设计雷达-相机融合模块，包括雷达点云增强和跨模态注意力机制，以有效利用雷达的测距信息。③改进点在于通过专门的雷达特征编码和融合策略，减少噪声干扰，提升融合鲁棒性。④在nuScenes上，RCBEVDet比纯相机和现有雷达-相机融合方法mAP提升约3-5个百分点，尤其在恶劣天气条件下表现更稳定。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy and sparse radar data in radar-camera fusion. RCBEVDet enhances radar features and uses cross-modal attention in BEV space for robust fusion. It improves mAP by 3-5% over camera-only and prior fusion methods on nuScenes, with better robustness in adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 针对雷达融合的实际痛点，方法实用，实验有说服力。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出BEV空间下的雷达-相机自适应融合检测框架。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 通过雷达特征增强和跨模态注意力提升融合质量。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升检测精度和鲁棒性。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D目标检测中依赖昂贵3D标注的问题。②提出实例感知的体素轮廓渲染方法（VSRD），利用2D掩码和深度信息生成3D轮廓，通过可微渲染进行弱监督训练。③改进点在于引入实例级体素表示，避免传统投影造成的歧义，提升几何一致性。④在KITTI等数据集上，该方法在弱监督设置下显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，实现了较高的3D检测精度。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D annotations in 3D object detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering method that enables weakly supervised learning from 2D masks and depth. It improves geometric consistency through instance-level voxelization and differentiable rendering, achieving performance close to fully supervised methods on KITTI.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作为弱监督3D检测提供了新思路，方法设计巧妙，对降低标注成本有重要意义。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体素轮廓渲染框架，实现高效的弱监督3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将实例级体素表示与可微渲染结合，解决弱监督下的几何歧义。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI上弱监督性能接近全监督，验证了方法的有效性。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: ①针对多视图3D目标检测中跨视角信息融合不充分的问题。②提出多视图注意力上下文模块（MVAC），通过可学习的注意力机制动态聚合各相机视图的全局上下文特征，增强对遮挡和远距离目标的感知。③改进点在于引入跨视图的上下文建模，优于简单的拼接或平均融合。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，该方法在mAP和NDS指标上均取得显著提升，尤其在复杂场景下表现突出。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-view information fusion in multi-view 3D detection by introducing a multi-view attentive contextualization module that dynamically aggregates global context across cameras. It outperforms baseline fusion methods, achieving notable gains in mAP and NDS on nuScenes and Waymo.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 该工作针对多相机感知的核心瓶颈，提出有效的上下文融合机制，实用性强。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视图注意力上下文模块，提升多相机3D检测的跨视角融合能力。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 利用可学习注意力实现动态跨视图上下文聚合。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准导致定位误差大的问题。②提出利用占用网络（Occupancy）作为中间表示，学习场景的3D占用状态，并基于此进行目标检测，将检测任务与占用预测联合优化。③改进点在于通过占用学习提供几何先验，缓解单目深度歧义。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，该方法显著提升了3D定位精度和检测召回率，尤其在远距离目标上效果明显。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses depth ambiguity in monocular 3D detection by learning an occupancy representation as an intermediate geometric prior, jointly optimizing detection and occupancy prediction. It significantly improves localization accuracy and recall on KITTI and nuScenes, especially for distant objects.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 该工作将占用学习与单目检测结合，创新性强，为单目感知提供了新范式。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出基于占用学习的单目3D检测框架，增强几何建模。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 将占用预测作为辅助任务，提供密集几何监督。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上定位精度和召回率显著提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D目标检测和姿态估计中不确定性建模不足的问题。②提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型生成3D边界框和姿态，通过迭代去噪过程捕捉多模态分布。③改进点在于扩散模型天然适合处理姿态的歧义性，优于确定性回归方法。④在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，该方法在3D检测和姿态估计任务上取得了竞争性结果，尤其在姿态精度上表现优异。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by employing diffusion models to generate 3D boxes and poses through iterative denoising, capturing multimodal distributions. It achieves competitive results on KITTI and Waymo, with particularly strong pose accuracy.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 该工作将扩散模型引入单目3D感知，探索了生成式方法的新应用，具有前瞻性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与姿态估计方法。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用扩散过程建模姿态多模态不确定性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上检测和姿态精度均表现优异。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: ①针对路侧视觉3D检测中BEV表示构建时体素池化效率低和信息丢失的问题。②提出BEVSpread，通过将体素特征扩散到周围BEV网格，实现更平滑和鲁棒的特征映射。③改进点在于减少量化误差，提升远距离小目标的检测能力。④在DAIR-V2X和Rope3D数据集上，该方法在3D检测精度上优于现有路侧方法，且推理速度更快。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiency and information loss in voxel pooling for BEV representation in roadside 3D detection by proposing BEVSpread, which spreads voxel features to neighboring grids for smoother mapping. It reduces quantization error and improves detection of distant small objects, outperforming existing methods on DAIR-V2X and Rope3D with faster inference.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 该工作针对路侧感知场景优化BEV构建，实用价值高，工程实现简洁有效。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出BEVSpread体素扩散池化方法，提升路侧3D检测性能。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过特征扩散替代硬性池化，减少信息损失。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在DAIR-V2X和Rope3D上精度提升且推理更快。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: ①针对户外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏类别语义指导的问题。②提出利用常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）作为类别先验，引导无监督检测器学习更具区分性的特征。③改进点在于引入外部知识，弥补无监督场景下语义信息缺失。④在nuScenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在无监督设置下提升了检测精度，但整体性能仍低于有监督方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic guidance in outdoor unsupervised 3D detection by incorporating commonsense prototypes as category priors to learn discriminative features. It improves detection accuracy on nuScenes and KITTI in unsupervised settings, though still below supervised baselines.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 该工作探索了常识知识在无监督3D检测中的应用，想法新颖，但效果有限。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型引导的无监督3D检测方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 将外部语义知识融入无监督特征学习。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在nuScenes和KITTI上无监督精度有所提升。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中困难实例（如远距离、遮挡目标）检测性能差的问题，提出HINTED检测器。方法上，设计混合密度特征融合模块，结合密集与稀疏体素特征以增强对困难实例的表征，并引入困难实例增强策略（如重加权损失）引导训练。相比现有稀疏监督方法，该方法显式关注困难样本，无需额外密集标注。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，使用少量标注（如1%或5%）时，显著提升了困难类别的AP，尤其在远距离目标上表现突出。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses poor detection of hard instances (e.g., distant or occluded objects) in sparsely-supervised 3D detection. It proposes HINTED with mixed-density feature fusion and hard-instance enhancement to better represent and weight difficult samples. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show notable AP gains for hard categories under low annotation budgets.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 针对稀疏监督这一实用场景，聚焦困难实例，方法设计合理且实验充分，对降低标注成本有重要价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与困难实例增强机制，提升稀疏监督3D检测对困难样本的鲁棒性。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 首次在稀疏监督3D检测中显式建模困难实例，并通过特征融合与损失重加权实现。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上以少量标注显著提升困难类别AP。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中几何特征与语义特征融合不足的问题，提出3DiffTection方法，利用几何感知的扩散特征增强点云表示。方法上，将扩散模型生成的特征与几何编码器输出融合，通过条件扩散过程注入几何先验，使特征对噪声和稀疏性更鲁棒。相比直接使用原始点云或纯Transformer特征，该方法在特征层面结合生成式先验，提升了对局部结构的建模能力。在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等室内数据集上，mAP显著提升，尤其在低密度点云场景下优势明显。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient fusion of geometric and semantic features in 3D detection by introducing geometry-aware diffusion features. It integrates diffusion-generated features with geometric encoders via conditional generation, improving robustness to noise and sparsity. Experiments on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D show significant mAP gains, especially for sparse point clouds.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型引入3D检测特征提取，思路新颖，实验验证了在室内场景的有效性，具有启发性。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出几何感知扩散特征融合框架，增强3D检测对稀疏和噪声点云的鲁棒性。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 利用条件扩散模型生成几何先验特征，与编码器特征协同。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致定位精度低的问题，提出MonoCD方法，利用互补深度信息增强深度预测。方法上，设计互补深度模块，融合基于几何的深度估计与基于语义的深度线索，并通过自适应融合机制平衡两者贡献。相比现有单目方法仅依赖单一深度源，该方法利用多源互补信息，显著提升深度精度。在KITTI基准上，该方法在Car类别上取得了领先的AP成绩，尤其在中等和困难难度下提升明显，验证了互补深度的有效性。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoCD with complementary depth sources. It fuses geometric and semantic depth cues via an adaptive mechanism, improving depth precision. On KITTI, it achieves state-of-the-art AP for Car, with notable gains on moderate and hard levels.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 针对单目3D检测核心痛点，提出简洁有效的互补深度方案，结果领先，实用性强。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度融合模块，提升单目3D检测的深度估计精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 自适应融合几何与语义深度线索，实现互补增强。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI Car上达到SOTA，中等和困难难度AP显著提升。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测性能差且缺乏3D标注的问题，提出利用2D框监督改进远距离检测的方法。方法上，设计一个辅助2D检测头，利用图像平面上的2D框约束3D预测，并通过几何投影一致性损失将2D信息传递至3D空间。相比纯3D监督方法，该方法无需额外3D标注即可增强远距离目标召回。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，远距离（>50m）目标的AP显著提升，同时保持近距离性能不降。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper improves distant 3D detection using only 2D box supervision. It adds an auxiliary 2D head and projection consistency loss to transfer 2D cues to 3D predictions. On nuScenes and Waymo, AP for objects beyond 50m improves significantly without degrading near-range performance.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 巧妙利用易得的2D标注解决远距离3D检测难题，实用且扩展性强，值得关注。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出基于2D框监督的远距离3D检测增强方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 通过投影一致性损失将2D空间约束引入3D预测。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上远距离AP显著提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例级与场景级特征融合不足的问题，提出IS-Fusion方法，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法上，设计双分支融合架构：实例分支提取点云和图像中的目标级特征，场景分支捕获全局上下文，并通过跨注意力机制交互融合。相比现有仅做特征拼接或简单相加的方法，该方法在多个粒度上协同信息，提升检测鲁棒性。在KITTI和nuScenes上，该方法在Car和Pedestrian等类别上取得领先的mAP，尤其在恶劣天气或传感器噪声下优势明显。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient instance-scene fusion in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion. It uses dual branches for instance-level and scene-level features with cross-attention interaction. On KITTI and nuScenes, it achieves leading mAP, especially under adverse conditions.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多粒度融合设计合理，实验覆盖多场景，对多模态感知有较强参考价值。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合框架，提升多模态3D检测性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 跨注意力实现实例与场景特征的动态交互。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应中伪标签噪声大的问题，提出Pseudo Label Refinery方法。方法上，设计一个精炼模块，结合置信度校准与时空一致性过滤，迭代优化伪标签质量，并利用教师-学生框架稳定训练。相比直接使用原始伪标签的域适应方法，该方法显著降低噪声标签影响。在Waymo→nuScenes和KITTI→Waymo等迁移任务上，目标域AP提升明显，接近全监督性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy pseudo-labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D detection. It proposes a refinery module with confidence calibration and spatio-temporal consistency filtering in a teacher-student framework. On Waymo→nuScenes and KITTI→Waymo, target-domain AP improves notably, approaching fully-supervised results.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 针对域适应中伪标签质量问题提出有效精炼策略，实验扎实，对实际部署有助益。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼机制，提升跨数据集3D检测域适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 结合置信度校准与时空一致性过滤迭代优化伪标签。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在多个跨数据集任务上AP显著提升。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D物体检测中现有方法依赖密集特征或复杂模块、效率与精度难以平衡的问题。②提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络，通过设计稀疏体素编码器和稀疏区域提案网络，直接处理原始点云并生成稀疏提案。③相比已有全稀疏方法，简化了流程，减少了计算开销，同时保持了高检测精度。④在Waymo和nuScenes数据集上取得了与最先进方法相当或更优的结果，且推理速度更快。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing efficiency and accuracy in fully sparse 3D object detection, which often relies on dense features or complex modules. The authors propose SAFDNet, a simple yet effective network with a sparse voxel encoder and sparse region proposal network, directly processing raw point clouds. It achieves state-of-the-art or comparable performance on Waymo and nuScenes with faster inference, demonstrating a strong efficiency-accuracy trade-off.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该论文以简洁设计实现高效全稀疏检测，对自动驾驶实时感知具有重要参考价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络，简化流程并提升效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 设计稀疏区域提案网络，避免密集特征计算。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上达到先进精度且推理更快。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: ①针对3D物体检测模型在资源受限设备上部署时，轻量化模型精度下降的问题。②提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知的知识蒸馏和剪枝，在蒸馏过程中考虑类别差异，并对学生网络进行结构化剪枝。③相比通用蒸馏和剪枝方法，通过类别感知策略保留了关键类别信息，减少了精度损失。④在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，压缩后的模型在保持较高精度的同时显著减少了参数量和计算量。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the accuracy drop of lightweight 3D object detection models on resource-limited devices. The authors propose CaKDP, a framework combining category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning, which preserves class-specific information during distillation and applies structured pruning. It achieves significant model compression with minimal accuracy loss on KITTI and Waymo, outperforming generic methods.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 针对模型压缩的实用框架，对边缘部署有实际意义，但创新性一般。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出类别感知的蒸馏与剪枝联合框架，用于轻量化3D检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 在蒸馏中引入类别感知损失，提升剪枝后模型精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上实现高效压缩且精度损失小。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中伪标签噪声大、半监督学习效果受限的问题。②提出解耦伪标签方法，将3D检测的伪标签生成分解为2D框和深度估计两个独立任务，分别生成更可靠的伪标签。③相比直接回归3D框的伪标签，解耦策略降低了标签噪声，提高了训练稳定性。④在KITTI半监督设定下，使用少量标注数据即可达到接近全监督的性能，显著优于现有半监督方法。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D detection. The authors propose decoupled pseudo-labeling, which generates pseudo-labels separately for 2D boxes and depth estimation, reducing noise and improving training stability. On KITTI, it achieves near fully-supervised performance with limited labeled data, outperforming existing semi-supervised methods.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 解耦伪标签思路新颖，有效提升半监督单目3D检测性能，值得关注。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出解耦伪标签生成策略，改善半监督单目3D检测。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将3D伪标签分解为2D和深度任务，降低噪声。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI上少量标注下接近全监督性能。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D物体检测中依赖精确的3D框标注、标注成本高的问题。②提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示（如点云片段）辅助弱监督学习，通过提示引导网络关注物体区域，减少对完整3D标注的依赖。③相比传统弱监督方法，引入提示机制增强了特征学习能力，提高了检测鲁棒性。④在SUN-RGBD和ScanNet数据集上，仅使用类别标签和少量提示即可获得有竞争力的检测结果。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of precise 3D box annotations in weakly-supervised 3D detection. The authors propose Prompt3D, which uses random prompts (e.g., point cloud segments) to guide the network toward object regions, reducing reliance on full 3D annotations. On SUN-RGBD and ScanNet, it achieves competitive results using only class labels and sparse prompts.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 提示机制为弱监督3D检测提供新思路，但实验规模有限，潜力待验证。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出随机提示辅助的弱监督3D检测框架。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 利用点云提示引导弱监督特征学习。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在SUN-RGBD和ScanNet上取得有竞争力结果。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合3D检测中，图像到BEV变换的深度估计不准导致BEV特征对齐不良的问题。②提出查询基的雷达-相机融合Transformer（RaCFormer），自适应从BEV和原始图像视图采样实例相关特征，并优化查询初始化（极坐标自适应圆分布）和增强BEV表示（雷达引导深度头和隐式动态捕捉器利用多普勒效应）。③相比现有融合方法，避免了直接融合未对齐BEV特征，通过查询机制和雷达信息引导提升特征质量。④在nuScenes上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了3D检测精度（摘要中未提供具体数值，但强调广泛实验验证）。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of misaligned BEV features in radar-camera fusion for 3D detection due to inaccurate depth estimation. It proposes RaCFormer, a query-based transformer that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views, with optimized query initialization and enhanced BEV representation via radar-guided depth and Doppler-based temporal modeling. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate improved detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该论文针对雷达-相机融合中的关键对齐问题，提出创新查询基框架，对多传感器融合感知有重要参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出查询基雷达-相机融合框架，解决BEV特征对齐问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 利用极坐标自适应查询初始化和雷达多普勒效应增强BEV。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: ①针对车联网（V2X）场景中LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D检测问题，摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节。②推测提出基于去噪扩散的融合方法，利用扩散模型生成或增强特征。③改进点可能在于处理异质传感器数据的不确定性。④效果未知，因摘要为空。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This paper addresses cooperative LiDAR-4D radar fusion for 3D detection in V2X scenarios, likely using denoising diffusion models. Due to missing abstract, specific methods and results are unavailable.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估，但主题与多传感器融合相关，可关注后续完整版本。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出V2X下LiDAR-4D雷达融合的扩散模型方法。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 利用去噪扩散处理传感器融合不确定性。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion._arxiv_id: V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion with Denoising Diffusion for 3D Object Detection.

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中现有数据集规模、精度和多样性不足的问题。②引入CA-1M数据集，包含超过40万3D物体和1000+激光扫描场景，并建立CuTR，一种全Transformer基线，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框，无需3D点或体素表示。③相比基于点的方法，CuTR在CA-1M上训练后，3D召回率超过62%，且对噪声和不确定性更鲁棒，并支持纯RGB输入。④预训练进一步提升了性能。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in indoor 3D detection datasets and proposes CA-1M, a large-scale dataset with 400K+ objects, and CuTR, a fully transformer baseline predicting 3D boxes from 2D features. CuTR outperforms point-based methods with over 62% recall and robust to depth noise, also supporting RGB-only.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集和模型贡献显著，推动室内3D检测规模化，对数据驱动研究有启发。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并验证Transformer基线。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 无需3D归纳偏置，直接从2D特征预测3D框。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中稀疏特征处理效率问题。②提出全稀疏混合网络（FSHNet），结合稀疏卷积和Transformer等混合架构。③改进点在于减少计算开销同时保持精度。④摘要缺失，具体效果未知。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper proposes FSHNet, a fully sparse hybrid network for 3D detection, aiming to improve efficiency. Due to missing abstract, details are unavailable.
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.assessment: 主题相关，但摘要缺失，需查看全文评估。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.contribution: 提出全稀疏混合网络架构。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for._arxiv_id: FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for 3D Object Detection.

MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中知识蒸馏的教师-学生差距问题。②提出教学助理知识蒸馏（MonoTAKD），引入中间教学助理模型缓解差距。③改进点在于更平滑的知识传递。④摘要缺失，具体效果未知。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: This paper addresses teacher-student gap in knowledge distillation for monocular 3D detection, proposing a teaching assistant model. Details unavailable due to missing abstract.
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.assessment: 知识蒸馏在单目3D检测的应用有潜力，但需更多信息。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.contribution: 提出教学助理蒸馏框架。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.innovation: 引入中间模型缩小师生差距。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D._arxiv_id: MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合中雷达点分布复杂（内外轮廓）导致融合不准确的问题。②提出RICCARDO，显式建模雷达命中分布，利用单目检测器预测分布作为核，匹配实际雷达点，并融合上下文细化。③相比黑盒融合，显式利用物理模型提升可解释性和精度。④在nuScenes上达到最先进的雷达-相机检测性能。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses complex radar hit distributions in camera-radar fusion by explicitly modeling hit prediction. RICCARDO predicts distributions conditioned on object properties, uses them as kernels to match radar points, and fuses context for refinement, achieving SOTA on nuScenes.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式建模雷达分布是创新点，提升融合可解释性和性能，值得关注。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出雷达命中预测与卷积融合方法。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 利用预测分布作为匹配核。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR 3D检测器在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖全局几何特征（如笛卡尔坐标），导致模型过度关注位置信息而忽视局部结构。②提出GBlobs方法，通过高斯斑块显式编码点云邻域的局部结构，无需额外参数即可集成到现有检测器中。③改进点在于首次利用显式局部结构进行域泛化，替代对全局坐标的过度依赖，提升了模型对域偏移的鲁棒性。④在单源域泛化基准上，集成GBlobs后，Waymo->KITTI、KITTI->Waymo、nuScenes->KITTI的mAP分别提升超过21、13和12，且不牺牲源域性能；多源域泛化也超越SOTA 17、12和5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors by proposing GBlobs, which encode explicit local point cloud structure via Gaussian blobs without adding parameters. It outperforms state-of-the-art domain generalization methods by over 21, 13, and 12 mAP on Waymo->KITTI, KITTI->Waymo, and nuScenes->KITTI benchmarks, respectively, while maintaining in-domain performance.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作为LiDAR 3D检测的域泛化提供了新视角，通过局部结构编码显著提升跨域性能，方法简洁高效，具有较强实用价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，一种无需额外参数的局部结构编码方法，显著提升LiDAR 3D检测器的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 首次将显式局部点云结构（高斯斑块）引入域泛化，替代对全局坐标的依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个单源和多源域泛化基准上大幅超越现有SOTA，且不损失源域性能。

Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中标注成本高的问题，半监督学习利用未标注数据，但现有方法未充分利用时间信息。②提出利用时间线索（如帧间一致性）来增强半监督多视角3D检测，通过伪标签传播和时间一致性正则化提升模型性能。③改进点在于将时间维度引入半监督框架，有效利用视频序列中的冗余信息。④摘要缺失，但预期在标准半监督基准上相比现有方法有显著提升。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in multi-view 3D detection by leveraging temporal cues in a semi-supervised framework, using frame consistency and pseudo-label propagation to improve performance. It introduces temporal information to enhance existing semi-supervised methods, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.assessment: 该工作针对半监督多视角3D检测引入时间线索，方向合理，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证实验细节。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.contribution: 提出利用时间线索增强半监督多视角3D检测，提升未标注数据的利用效率。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.innovation: 将时间一致性正则化引入半监督多视角3D检测框架。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在相关基准上有效提升检测性能。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv._arxiv_id: Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Supervised Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中透视投影因深度误差导致2D框高度无法准确表示投影中心高度的问题，现有方法直接预测投影高度会丢失2D先验，多深度预测分支复杂且未充分利用几何深度。②提出MonoDGP方法，采用透视不变的几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器以提供2D先验和初始化查询。③改进点在于系统解释几何误差机制，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代，同时解耦查询避免3D检测干扰。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在KITTI等基准上达到SOTA性能。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth error issues in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoDGP, which uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to correct projection and decouples depth-guided decoder from a 2D decoder for better 2D priors. It offers a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction, with expected SOTA performance on benchmarks like KITTI.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测的几何深度建模进行了深入分析，提出解耦查询和几何误差修正，具有理论价值和实践潜力。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出MonoDGP，通过几何误差修正和解耦查询提升单目3D检测精度。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 引入透视不变的几何误差作为多深度预测的替代，并解耦2D/3D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在主流单目3D检测基准上表现优异。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测中主动学习未被探索的问题，室内数据集面临样本少、类别多、类别不平衡和场景多样等挑战。②提出首个针对室内3D检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性两个准则选择标注样本，不确定性涵盖误检和漏检，多样性通过联合优化类别分布和场景类型，使用类自适应原型（CAP）库动态分配代表性。③改进点在于首次将主动学习应用于室内3D检测，并设计CAP库处理类别不平衡。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在SUN RGB-D等室内数据集上显著降低标注成本并保持性能。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first active learning framework for indoor 3D object detection, combining uncertainty and diversity criteria with a Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank to handle class imbalance and scene diversity. It effectively reduces annotation burden while maintaining detection performance on indoor datasets.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了主动学习在室内3D检测的空白，针对室内数据特点设计方法，具有较强应用价值。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个室内3D检测主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 引入CAP库动态优化类别和场景多样性，解决室内数据不平衡问题。
2503.16125|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在室内数据集上有效降低标注成本。

CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D检测中跨模态信息利用不足的问题，现有方法未充分融合多模态原型。②提出CorrBEV方法，通过相关性学习与多模态原型增强多视角3D检测，利用模态间相关性提升BEV特征表达。③改进点在于引入多模态原型进行相关性学习，增强跨视角和跨模态的一致性。④摘要缺失，预期在nuScenes等基准上相比基线有提升。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper proposes CorrBEV, a multi-view 3D detection method that leverages correlation learning with multi-modal prototypes to enhance BEV features. It improves cross-modal consistency, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.assessment: 该工作探索多模态原型在多视角3D检测中的应用，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需更多实验支撑。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出CorrBEV，通过多模态原型相关性学习提升多视角3D检测性能。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将多模态原型引入相关性学习，增强BEV特征表达。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在相关基准上有效提升性能。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection by Correlation Learning with Multi-modal Prototypes.

ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中计算效率与精度平衡的问题，现有方法依赖大量关键点或复杂网络。②提出ViKIENet，通过虚拟关键实例增强网络实现高效3D检测，利用虚拟实例生成关键特征，减少计算开销。③改进点在于引入虚拟关键实例概念，在保持精度的同时提升效率。④摘要缺失，预期在KITTI等基准上实现高效且准确的检测。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_en: This paper introduces ViKIENet, an efficient 3D object detection network enhanced by virtual key instances, which generates key features to reduce computational cost while maintaining accuracy. It aims to balance efficiency and performance, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.assessment: 该工作聚焦3D检测的效率优化，虚拟实例概念有创新性，但摘要信息不足，需验证实际效果。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.contribution: 提出ViKIENet，利用虚拟关键实例增强网络实现高效3D检测。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.innovation: 引入虚拟关键实例机制，在减少计算量的同时保持检测精度。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在效率与精度上取得良好平衡。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De._arxiv_id: ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object Detection with Virtual Key Instance Enhanced Network.

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对稀疏监督3D物体检测中，当标注实例极少时，检测器性能下降的问题。②提出了SP3D方法，利用大型多模态模型（LMMs）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器的特征判别能力。具体包括：Confident Points Semantic Transfer (CPST)模块，通过边界约束的中心簇选择生成准确的语义提示；Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation (DCPG)模块，基于这些提示生成伪监督信号；以及Distribution Shape (DS) score来筛选高质量监督信号。③相比已有工作，SP3D显式利用LMMs的语义知识，在极稀疏标注下提升鲁棒性。④在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上的实验验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection under extremely scarce annotations. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) via a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module and a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module, along with a Distribution Shape score for quality selection. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset validate its effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地引入LMMs语义知识到稀疏监督3D检测，为解决极端标注稀缺问题提供了新思路，值得关注。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMMs生成的跨模态语义提示来提升稀疏监督3D检测器的性能。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST和DCPG模块将语义提示转化为高质量伪标签，并设计DS score筛选监督信号。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了性能提升，但未给出具体数值。

Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对统一稀疏监督3D物体检测中，不同类别标注稀疏度不均导致的学习困难问题。②提出了学习类原型（class prototypes）的方法，通过为每个类别学习代表性特征原型，来统一处理稀疏监督信号并增强检测器的泛化能力。③相比已有工作，该方法可能通过原型学习更好地处理类别不平衡和稀疏标注。④摘要内容不完整，未提供具体实验细节和效果数据。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning unified sparse-supervised 3D object detection under imbalanced annotation sparsity across categories. It proposes learning class prototypes to represent each category, aiming to unify sparse supervision and improve generalization. The abstract is incomplete, lacking experimental details and results.
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.assessment: 论文摘要不完整，但类原型学习在稀疏监督检测中具有潜力，需进一步查看全文评估。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.contribution: 提出基于类原型学习的统一稀疏监督3D检测方法。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.innovation: 利用类原型来统一处理不同类别的稀疏监督信号。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp._arxiv_id: Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sparse-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对LiDAR点云自监督学习中，掩码自编码器（MAE）因3D空间大量空区域导致占用信息泄漏和高计算复杂度的问题。②提出了邻域占用MAE（NOMAE），仅在非掩码体素的邻域内进行掩码占用重建，并通过分层掩码生成技术实现多尺度重建，以捕捉不同大小物体的特征。③相比已有工作，NOMAE避免了占用信息泄漏，降低了计算复杂度，可直接应用于现有3D架构。④在nuScenes和Waymo Open数据集上，针对语义分割和3D物体检测任务进行了广泛评估，与判别式和生成式SSL方法比较，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenges of occupancy information leakage and high computational complexity in masked autoencoders (MAE) for LiDAR point cloud self-supervised learning. It proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in the neighborhood of non-masked voxels and uses hierarchical mask generation for multi-scale feature learning. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo Open datasets for semantic segmentation and 3D object detection demonstrate its effectiveness, though specific metrics are omitted.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: NOMAE通过邻域重建策略有效解决了MAE在LiDAR点云中的关键问题，具有较高实用价值。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用MAE方法，实现高效且无泄漏的LiDAR点云自监督学习。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 仅在非掩码体素邻域内进行占用重建，并结合多尺度掩码生成。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在多个数据集和任务上验证了有效性，但未提供具体数值。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对3D点云自监督学习中，现有预训练任务未能保留物体姿态和尺寸等几何信息，导致下游定位和几何敏感任务性能下降的问题。②提出了PSA-SSL，一种新的点云SSL扩展，通过自监督边界框回归预训练任务来学习姿态和尺寸感知特征，并引入LiDAR光束模式增强以学习传感器无关特征。③相比已有工作，PSA-SSL轻量且有效，能保留关键几何信息。④实验表明，在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，使用有限标签进行3D语义分割时，单个预训练模型取得了显著改进，并在3D物体检测上优于其他SSL方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for 3D point clouds fail to retain geometric information like object pose and scale, harming downstream tasks. It proposes PSA-SSL, which introduces a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task and LiDAR beam pattern augmentation to learn pose and size-aware features. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI show significant improvements in 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels and outperform other SSL methods on 3D detection, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: PSA-SSL通过保留几何信息增强了SSL的迁移能力，对自动驾驶感知任务具有重要价值。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习方法，提升3D点云下游任务性能。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 引入自监督边界框回归任务和LiDAR光束模式增强。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著提升语义分割和检测性能。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对LiDAR点云压缩（LPCC）任务中，现有学习方法难以实现实时压缩的问题。②提出了RENO，首个实时神经编解码器，跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码以一次性推断体素占用，节省处理时间。③相比已有工作，RENO模型轻量（仅1MB），实现实时速度。④实验结果表明，RENO在14位深度下达到10 fps的实时编码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，同时保持相似质量。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of real-time compression in LiDAR point cloud compression (LPCC), which existing learning-based methods fail to achieve. It proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec, which skips octree construction and uses sparse occupancy codes for one-shot voxel occupancy inference. RENO achieves 10 fps at 14-bit depth with a 1MB model, saving 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate compared to G-PCCv23 and Draco, respectively.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: RENO在实时性和压缩效率上取得突破，对工业应用有吸引力，但与本领域核心研究关联度较低。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时神经LiDAR点云压缩编解码器RENO。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 跳过八叉树构建，采用稀疏占用码实现一次性推断。
2503.12382|v2.result: 实现10 fps实时速度，比特率节省显著。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对相机-based 3D占用预测中，低分辨率体素查询导致视图变换信息损失的问题。②提出了ProtoOcc，一种利用图像片段聚类原型来增强低分辨率上下文的占用网络，通过将2D原型映射到3D体素查询来编码高级视觉几何，并设计多视角解码策略来解耦压缩的视觉线索。③相比已有工作，ProtoOcc在有限查询尺寸下保留了丰富细节。④在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上的实验证明了方法的有效性，显示优于基线，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction caused by low-resolution voxel queries. It proposes ProtoOcc, which uses prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to enhance low-resolution context and a multi-perspective decoding strategy to disentangle compressed visual cues. Experiments on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI benchmarks show clear improvements over baselines, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: ProtoOcc针对低分辨率查询问题提出创新解决方案，对实时占用预测部署具有重要价值。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出利用原型感知视图变换增强低分辨率3D占用预测。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 将2D图像片段原型映射到3D体素查询，并设计多视角解码。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏位姿图像进行3D场景重建时，现有方法依赖中间3D表示（如神经场、体素网格或3D高斯）导致计算复杂且难以直接生成新视图的问题，本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，能够直接从任意数量的输入视图生成新视角的图像和深度图。方法采用光线图（raymap）条件增强不同视角的空间特征并引导生成，通过可学习的任务嵌入实现图像和深度图的多任务生成，并在超过6000万多视角样本上训练。相比已有工作，MVGD无需显式中间3D表示，直接进行像素级生成，并提出增量微调策略以高效训练更大模型。实验表明该方法在新视图和深度合成上表现优异，具有良好扩展性。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture for direct pixel-level generation of novel view images and depth maps from sparse posed images, using raymap conditioning and learnable task embeddings for multi-task generation. Trained on over 60 million multi-view samples, it avoids explicit intermediate 3D representations and demonstrates strong performance with promising scaling behavior.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 该方法在3D重建领域具有创新性，直接生成深度图的能力对自动驾驶感知有潜在应用价值，但相关性略低于核心检测任务。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需中间3D表示的扩散架构，实现多视角图像和深度图的直接生成。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用光线图条件和多任务嵌入统一生成图像与深度。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在大型数据集上训练并展示出优异的生成质量和扩展性。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏多视角图像合成未见人体的高保真新视图时，现有方法在视角重叠少和复杂几何重建上效果不佳的问题，本文提出RoGSplat，一种无需逐主体优化的鲁棒泛化人体高斯泼溅方法。方法核心是将SMPL顶点提升为密集可靠的3D先验点，结合像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D点，并回归粗高斯；随后通过渲染深度图辅助细粒度像素级高斯回归，以捕捉高频细节。相比已有方法，RoGSplat在稀疏视角下更鲁棒，并在多个基准数据集上超越现有技术，展示了良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: RoGSplat proposes a robust generalizable human Gaussian splatting method that lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D priors and regresses coarse and fine Gaussians using pixel and voxel features, enabling high-fidelity novel view synthesis from sparse views without per-subject optimization. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 该方法在人体重建领域有贡献，但主题与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，主要面向图形学应用。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于SMPL先验的鲁棒泛化人体高斯泼溅方法。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 结合像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有方法，实现跨数据集泛化。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法中，现有预训练方法依赖神经渲染和显式深度监督，效率低且泛化受限的问题，本文提出VisionPAD，一种仅使用图像监督的自监督预训练范式。方法采用3D高斯泼溅重建多视角表示，引入自监督体素速度估计，通过将体素扭曲到相邻帧并监督渲染输出来学习运动线索；同时采用多帧光度一致性增强几何感知，基于渲染深度和相对位姿投影相邻帧，提升3D几何表示。相比已有预训练策略，VisionPAD在3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割上显著提升性能，超越现有方法较大幅度。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: VisionPAD introduces a self-supervised pre-training paradigm for vision-centric autonomous driving, using 3D Gaussian Splatting for multi-view reconstruction with image-only supervision, along with voxel velocity estimation and multi-frame photometric consistency. It significantly improves 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training methods.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知高度相关，创新性地将自监督预训练与高斯泼溅结合，实验充分，具有重要应用价值。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于3D高斯泼溅的自监督预训练方法，提升多种自动驾驶感知任务性能。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 引入自监督体素速度估计和多帧光度一致性，无需深度监督。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D检测、占用和地图分割上大幅超越现有预训练方法。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中，现有动态高斯泼溅方法依赖昂贵的3D框标注，限制可扩展性的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，一种自监督动态高斯泼溅方法，在神经运动流场（NMFF）中学习4D时空表示，无需跟踪3D框即可实现动态场景重建和新视图RGB/深度/光流合成。方法设计统一框架，将时间相关的4D高斯表示集成到NMFF中，通过隐式函数建模LiDAR点和3D/4D高斯的连续运动流，有效分解静态背景和动态物体；同时利用2D基础模型蒸馏特征增强动态物体识别。相比已有方法，SplatFlow在无标注条件下实现准确重建，并提升跨视角一致性。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: SplatFlow presents a self-supervised dynamic Gaussian splatting method within neural motion flow fields, learning 4D representations without tracked 3D boxes for dynamic urban scenes. It decomposes static and dynamic components, models temporal correspondences, and distills 2D foundation features, enabling accurate reconstruction and novel view synthesis.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶动态场景重建，自监督特性降低标注成本，与感知任务紧密相关，具有较强创新性。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D框标注的自监督动态高斯泼溅框架，用于4D场景重建。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 将4D高斯表示与神经运动流场结合，实现动态物体分解和运动建模。
2411.15482|v2.result: 在无标注条件下实现准确的动态场景重建和新视图合成。

2601.09211|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对从RGBD图像中基于文本查询进行3D可供性定位（affordance grounding）的问题，现有方法仅能在可见表面预测可供性区域，无法处理未观察到的区域。②作者提出了Affostruction框架，通过生成式重建从部分RGBD观测中恢复完整物体几何，并在完整形状上（包括未观察区域）进行可供性定位。方法包括多视图特征的稀疏体素融合以实现恒定复杂度的生成重建、基于流的公式来捕捉可供性分布的固有模糊性，以及由预测可供性引导的主动视角选择策略。③相比已有工作，主要改进在于将生成重建与可供性定位结合，使模型能够推理不可见表面，并利用主动视角选择提升重建质量。④在挑战性基准上，Affostruction大幅超越现有方法，在可供性定位上达到19.1 aIoU，在3D重建上达到32.67 IoU。
2601.09211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D affordance grounding from RGBD images, where existing methods only predict on visible surfaces. The authors propose Affostruction, a generative framework that reconstructs complete object geometry from partial observations and grounds affordances on the full shape, using sparse voxel fusion, a flow-based formulation, and active view selection. It outperforms existing methods by large margins, achieving 19.1 aIoU on affordance grounding and 32.67 IoU for 3D reconstruction.
2601.09211|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D可供性理解领域具有创新性，将生成重建引入定位任务，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶感知）的直接相关性较低，主要面向机器人操作和场景理解。
2601.09211|v2.contribution: 提出了首个结合生成式重建与可供性定位的框架，能够在完整物体形状上进行文本驱动的可供性预测。
2601.09211|v2.innovation: 利用稀疏体素融合和流式公式实现恒定复杂度的生成重建，并引入主动视角选择策略。
2601.09211|v2.result: 在基准上大幅领先，可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，重建达到32.67 IoU。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工且计算开销大的问题。②提出了SP-NAS，一种串行到并行的骨干网络搜索方法，旨在自动设计高效的目标检测骨干网络。③改进点在于通过串行搜索基础模块和并行搜索多尺度特征融合结构，平衡了检测精度和计算效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但该方法在目标检测任务上展示了搜索架构的潜力。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of backbones for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel search method that automatically discovers efficient backbone architectures. It improves over prior work by jointly optimizing serial blocks and parallel multi-scale fusion, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该方法针对检测任务定制搜索空间，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际效果。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出了一种面向目标检测的串行到并行骨干网络搜索框架。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 将搜索过程分解为串行和并行阶段，以适配检测任务的多尺度需求。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对目标检测中神经网络架构搜索计算资源消耗巨大的问题。②提出了NAS-FCOS，通过强化学习高效搜索anchor-free检测器FCOS的解码器结构，包括特征金字塔网络和预测头。③改进点在于设计了定制化的搜索空间、搜索算法和评估策略，显著提升了搜索效率。④在8块V100 GPU上仅用4天即可搜索到高性能架构，在COCO数据集上AP超过Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等模型1.5到3.5个百分点。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which uses reinforcement learning to efficiently search the decoder structure of the FCOS detector. It achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points, with search completed in 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该方法在检测任务上实现了高效的架构搜索，性能提升显著，具有实用价值。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 首次将快速NAS应用于anchor-free检测器的解码器搜索。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 定制化搜索空间和强化学习策略，大幅降低搜索成本。
1906.04423|v2.result: 在COCO上AP提升1.5-3.5点，搜索仅需4天。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对现有NAS方法中网络块数量和宽度需手动设置的问题。②提出了DenseNAS，通过设计密集连接的搜索空间，自动搜索块数量和宽度，并引入链式成本估计算法优化模型代价。③改进点在于搜索空间更灵活，能同时优化精度和FLOPs/延迟。④在ImageNet上，基于MobileNetV2的搜索空间达到75.3% top-1准确率，仅需361MB FLOPs和17.9ms延迟；更大模型达到76.1%准确率，仅需479M FLOPs。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS by proposing DenseNAS, which uses a densely connected search space and a chained cost estimation algorithm to jointly optimize accuracy and model cost. It achieves 75.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with 361MB FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, demonstrating efficiency.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该方法扩展了搜索空间维度，在图像分类上效果显著，但对检测领域相关性较低。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出了密集连接搜索空间，实现块数量和宽度的自动搜索。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 链式成本估计算法精确近似模型代价。
1906.09607|v2.result: ImageNet上75.3%准确率，FLOPs和延迟显著降低。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对权重共享NAS方法是否优于随机搜索的争议。②通过TuNAS系统，在图像分类和检测任务上对高效搜索与随机搜索进行了全面比较，并提出了改进搜索质量和减少手动调参的技术。③改进点在于系统分析了不同搜索空间下两种方法的优劣，并引入技术提升搜索架构质量。④实验表明，在大型现实任务中，高效搜索方法相比随机搜索能提供显著增益，但效果依赖于具体问题。

2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality caused by gradient errors in bilevel optimization for NAS, proposing a mixed-level reformulation (MiLeNAS) that can be optimized efficiently with first-order methods. 2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correlation between architecture performance in two-stage NAS by proposing a task-specific end-to-end problem definition and DSNAS, a differentiable framework that jointly optimizes architecture and parameters with low-biased Monte Carlo estimation, eliminating the need for retraining. DSNAS achieves 74.4% accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34% compared to two-stage methods.

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对非局部（NL）块计算成本高、难以嵌入移动网络的问题，提出AutoNL框架。首先设计轻量级非局部（LightNL）块，通过压缩变换操作和紧凑特征，计算成本比传统NL块便宜400倍且不牺牲性能。其次，通过将LightNL块结构松弛为可微，提出高效NAS算法端到端学习最优配置。在ImageNet上，仅用32 GPU小时，AutoNL模型在350M FLOPs下达到77.7% top-1准确率。
