Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云运动估计中速度与精度平衡的问题，现有方法计算复杂度高。②提出了Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network，通过顺序多视角融合实现快速点云运动估计。③相比已有方法，该方法在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调快速性能。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.summary_en: This paper presents a sequential multi-view fusion network for fast LiDAR point motion estimation, aiming to balance speed and accuracy. It improves inference efficiency while maintaining performance, though specific metrics are not detailed.
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.assessment: 该方法对自动驾驶中的实时运动估计有应用价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步评估。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.contribution: 提出顺序多视角融合网络用于快速LiDAR点云运动估计。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.innovation: 通过顺序融合策略降低计算复杂度。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.result: 未提供具体数据，但强调速度提升。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for._arxiv_id: Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for Fast LiDAR Point Motion Estimation.

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督多视图立体（MVS）中因非朗伯表面和遮挡导致的跨视图对应匹配模糊问题。②提出RC-MVSNet，引入神经渲染，通过深度渲染一致性损失约束几何特征接近物体表面以缓解遮挡，并利用参考视图合成损失为即使非朗伯表面提供一致监督。③相比依赖光度一致性的现有无监督方法，创新性地结合神经渲染解决对应歧义。④在DTU和Tanks&Temples基准上达到无监督MVS最先进性能，且与许多监督方法相当。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence ambiguity in unsupervised multi-view stereo caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions. It proposes RC-MVSNet with neural rendering, imposing a depth rendering consistency loss and a reference view synthesis loss to handle these issues. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on DTU and Tanks&Temples benchmarks among unsupervised frameworks, competitive with supervised methods.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 该工作将神经渲染引入无监督MVS，有效解决真实场景中的匹配难题，对自动驾驶多视角几何重建有参考价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督MVS框架，解决非朗伯表面和遮挡下的对应匹配问题。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 利用深度渲染一致性和视图合成损失作为几何约束，替代传统光度一致性假设。
2203.03949|v2.result: 在DTU和Tanks&Temples上达到无监督SOTA，性能接近监督方法。

KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.summary_cn: ①针对自监督多视图立体（MVS）中缺乏强监督导致深度估计精度有限的问题。②提出KD-MVS，利用知识蒸馏框架，将教师网络（可能为监督或更优模型）的知识迁移至学生网络，以提升自监督学习效果。③相比纯自监督方法，通过蒸馏引入额外监督信号，增强特征表示。④摘要缺失，但预期在标准MVS基准上相比自监督基线有显著提升。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited accuracy of self-supervised multi-view stereo by introducing a knowledge distillation framework, KD-MVS, to transfer knowledge from a teacher to a student network. This approach enhances feature learning beyond pure self-supervision. Expected improvements on MVS benchmarks are implied but not detailed due to missing abstract.
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.assessment: 知识蒸馏在MVS自监督中的应用具有潜力，但摘要缺失，需进一步验证其创新性和效果。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.contribution: 提出知识蒸馏策略用于自监督MVS，提升深度估计性能。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.innovation: 将知识蒸馏引入MVS自监督学习，利用教师网络提供额外监督。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.result: 预期在MVS基准上优于自监督基线，但具体数据未提供。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel._arxiv_id: KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Self-supervised Learning for Multi-view Stereo.

FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D人体运动重建中依赖相机外参标定的问题。②提出FLEX方法，无需外参即可从多视角图像重建3D人体运动，可能通过隐式学习相机关系。③相比传统方法，消除了外参标定误差和繁琐流程，提升泛化性。④摘要缺失，预期在人体运动重建基准上展示鲁棒性。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependency on camera extrinsic calibration in multi-view 3D human motion reconstruction. FLEX proposes an extrinsic-free approach, likely learning implicit camera relationships, to reconstruct motion directly. This improves generalization by removing calibration requirements, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.assessment: 免外参设计对实际应用有吸引力，但领域与自动驾驶感知关联度较低。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.contribution: 提出无需相机外参的多视角3D人体运动重建方法。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.innovation: 通过隐式建模相机关系，免除显式外参标定。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.result: 预期在运动重建任务上表现鲁棒，但数据未提供。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi._arxiv_id: FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-view 3D Human Motion Reconstruction.

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统3D几何方法（如代价体、对极约束）任务特化导致泛化性差的问题。②提出Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe)，学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，将几何先验作为输入而非约束，并引入3D数据增强和视图合成辅助任务。③相比监督和传统方法，无需显式几何约束，提升零样本泛化能力。④在立体和视频深度估计上达到SOTA，零样本域泛化大幅提升。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor domain generalization in task-specific 3D geometry methods by proposing Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe), which learn an implicit multi-view consistent representation with geometric priors as inputs. It introduces 3D augmentations and view synthesis as auxiliary tasks. DeFiNe achieves state-of-the-art results in stereo and video depth estimation with significant zero-shot generalization improvements.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 该工作代表通用场景表示趋势，对自动驾驶多相机深度估计的泛化性有重要启示。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出隐式多视图场景表示网络，无需显式几何约束即可实现高精度深度估计。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 将几何先验作为输入并利用3D增强和视图合成提升泛化。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在立体和视频深度估计上达到SOTA，零样本泛化大幅提升。

Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.summary_cn: ①针对面部情绪识别中多视角信息利用不足的问题。②提出情绪感知的多视角对比学习方法，可能结合多视角特征和情绪标签进行对比学习。③相比传统单视角方法，增强跨视角情绪特征一致性。④摘要缺失，预期在面部情绪识别基准上提升准确率。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-view information utilization in facial emotion recognition. It proposes an emotion-aware multi-view contrastive learning method to enhance cross-view feature consistency. Improvements on emotion recognition benchmarks are expected but not detailed due to missing abstract.
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.assessment: 领域与自动驾驶感知无关，但对比学习策略有一定通用性。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.contribution: 提出情绪感知的多视角对比学习框架。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.innovation: 将情绪标签融入对比学习以增强多视角特征。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.result: 预期提升情绪识别准确率，但数据未提供。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea._arxiv_id: Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Learning for Facial Emotion Recognition.

MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.summary_cn: ①针对360度相机多视角全景深度估计中的几何一致性和大视场挑战。②提出MODE方法，利用多视角全景相机进行深度估计，可能结合球面几何或跨视角融合。③相比单目全景方法，利用多视角信息提升深度精度和鲁棒性。④摘要缺失，预期在360度深度估计基准上达到SOTA。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.summary_en: This paper addresses depth estimation challenges with 360-degree multi-camera setups, focusing on geometric consistency and wide field-of-view. MODE leverages multi-view omnidirectional images, likely with spherical geometry or cross-view fusion, to improve accuracy. State-of-the-art performance on omnidirectional depth benchmarks is expected, though specific results are unavailable.
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.assessment: 360度多相机深度估计对自动驾驶环视感知有直接应用价值，方法设计值得关注。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.contribution: 提出多视角全景深度估计方法，处理大视场几何一致性。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.innovation: 结合多视角全景相机信息进行深度估计。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.result: 预期在相关基准上达到SOTA，但数据未提供。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E._arxiv_id: MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth Estimation with 360$\circ $ Cameras.

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像中头发几何与外观建模的挑战，现有方法难以同时实现高保真渲染和直观控制。②提出Neural Strands框架，基于神经头皮纹理编码每根发丝几何与外观，并通过光栅化实现神经渲染。③相比体积方法，支持实时渲染、视角一致和抗锯齿，首次联合学习外观与显式头发几何。④实验表明在多种发型上实现高保真和高效渲染，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses accurate hair geometry and appearance modeling from multi-view images. It introduces Neural Strands with a neural scalp texture and strand-accurate rasterization, enabling real-time photorealistic rendering and joint learning of geometry and appearance. The method demonstrates high fidelity and efficiency across various hairstyles.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该论文在头发建模领域具有创新性，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经头皮纹理的显式发丝表示和光栅化神经渲染框架。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 首次实现多视角设置下外观与显式头发几何的联合学习。
2207.14067|v2.result: 实现实时高保真头发渲染，支持视角一致和抗锯齿效果。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: ①针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，现有自监督方法在2D或3D单独使用效果有限。②提出MvDeCor，利用2D自监督技术，通过多视角渲染和对比学习框架中的密集对应学习，获得视角不变和几何一致的2D表示。③相比仅用2D或3D自监督的方法，在有限标注下泛化更好，尤其受益于2D处理和3D几何推理的结合。④在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，细粒度部件分割优于现有方法，且在稀疏视角或纹理形状下改进更大。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles fine-grained 3D segmentation with limited labels by leveraging 2D self-supervised learning. MvDeCor renders shapes from multiple views and learns dense correspondences via contrastive learning, yielding view-invariant representations. It outperforms state-of-the-art on RenderPeople and PartNet, especially with sparse views or textured shapes.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 方法有创新性，但面向3D形状分割，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出多视角密集对应自监督学习框架用于细粒度3D分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 结合2D自监督和3D几何推理，提升有限标注下的泛化能力。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在RenderPeople和PartNet上优于现有方法，稀疏视图下改进更显著。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准的问题。②构建包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型和847,000张真实RGB-D图像的数据集，并半自动标注相机和物体位姿。③该数据集填补了真实世界多视角重建基准的空白，支持形状重建、位姿估计等任务。④提供完整标注、工具和基线，便于社区使用。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction. It presents a dataset of 998 objects with 847k RGB-D images and accurate pose annotations. The dataset fills a gap and supports various 3D tasks, with tools and baselines provided.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 数据集构建有价值，但主要面向通用3D重建，对自动驾驶感知的直接贡献有限。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 提供大规模真实世界多视角3D重建数据集及标注工具。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 首个针对多视角重建的真实世界桌面物体数据集。
2203.11397|v2.result: 包含998个模型和847k图像，支持多种3D应用。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: ①针对学习型多视角立体（MVS）方法中成本体积融合效率低、未充分利用3D空间关联的问题。②提出MVSTER，利用极线Transformer同时学习2D语义和3D空间关联，采用可分离的单目深度估计增强语义，并通过交叉注意力沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联。③相比使用额外网络学习融合线索的方法，MVSTER更高效且利用3D相关性。④在DTU基准上，相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别提升34%和14%的相对精度，且效率更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper improves multi-view stereo by addressing inefficient cost volume fusion. MVSTER uses an epipolar Transformer to jointly learn 2D semantics and 3D spatial associations, with a detachable monocular depth estimator. It achieves 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet on DTU with higher efficiency.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 方法在MVS领域有显著性能提升，与3D重建相关，但非自动驾驶核心方向。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出极线Transformer用于高效MVS成本体积融合。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 利用交叉注意力沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上相对MVSNet提升34%，效率更高。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper has no abstract provided, making it impossible to assess its problem, method, or results. It lacks sufficient content for evaluation.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估其学术价值。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法多阶段累积误差的问题。②提出PS-NeRF，基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法，联合估计几何、材质和光照，利用多光图像估计法线并正则化神经辐射场，通过阴影感知可微渲染优化。③相比分阶段方法，实现端到端联合优化，减少误差。④在合成和真实数据集上，形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses accumulated errors in traditional multi-view photometric stereo. PS-NeRF jointly estimates geometry, materials, and lights via implicit representation and shadow-aware differentiable rendering. It achieves far more accurate shape reconstruction than existing methods on synthetic and real datasets.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 方法在逆渲染领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经辐射场的联合逆渲染框架用于MVPS。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 利用阴影感知可微渲染联合优化法线、BRDF和光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上重建精度显著优于现有方法。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: ① 针对购物场景中多视角图像的无遮挡实例分割问题，现有基准缺乏大规模标注数据。② 提出了MUVA，一个大规模多视角无遮挡实例分割基准，包含新的数据集和评估协议。③ 相比已有工作，该基准专门针对购物场景，提供了多视角标注和更细粒度的遮挡处理。④ 实验表明该基准能有效评估和推动多视角无遮挡实例分割方法的发展。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios. It introduces MUVA, a new benchmark with a comprehensive dataset and evaluation protocols. The work provides a dedicated resource to advance research in this specific domain.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 该论文填补了购物场景下多视角无遮挡分割基准的空白，对相关应用研究有参考价值。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出了首个面向购物场景的大规模多视角无遮挡实例分割基准MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 构建了包含多视角标注的购物场景数据集和评估协议。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 提供了有效评估多视角无遮挡分割方法的基准。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对现有V2V协同感知方法仅适用于同质传感器配置的问题，限制了跨模态交互和协作规模。② 提出了HM-ViT，首个统一的异质多智能体协同感知框架，能处理不同传感器模态的智能体，并设计了异质3D图Transformer来融合多视角图像和LiDAR点云特征。③ 相比已有工作，该方法支持动态变化的智能体数量和类型，实现了跨模态的协同3D目标检测。④ 在OPV2V数据集上的实验表明，HM-ViT在异质V2V协同感知任务上优于现有SOTA方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of existing V2V cooperative perception methods that assume homogeneous sensor configurations. It proposes HM-ViT, the first unified framework for hetero-modal multi-agent cooperation, using a novel heterogeneous 3D graph transformer to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR features. Experiments on OPV2V demonstrate superior performance over SOTA methods.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了V2V感知中传感器异构的关键问题，具有较高的实用价值和创新性。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出了首个支持异质传感器模态的V2V协同感知框架HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计了异质3D图Transformer以联合推理智能体间和智能体内的交互。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在OPV2V数据集上超越了现有协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对域偏移导致目标检测模型在未知域性能下降的问题，现有域对抗学习忽略了公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。② 提出了基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含虚假相关生成器（SCG）和多视角域分类器（MVDC），通过多视角对抗训练去除非因果因素。③ 相比已有工作，该方法利用数据多模态结构，在多个潜在空间中发现并移除非因果因素，从而纯化域不变特征。④ 实验表明该方法在多个域泛化基准上提升了目标检测性能。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of non-causal factors in domain-invariant features for object detection under domain shift. It proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) framework with a Spurious Correlations Generator and a Multi-View Domain Classifier to purify features. The method improves detection performance on unseen domains.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 该论文从因果视角分析域泛化问题，方法新颖且实验充分，对开放场景检测有重要启示。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出了基于多视角对抗判别器的域泛化目标检测方法。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角对抗训练来挖掘并移除公共特征中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.result: 在多个域泛化数据集上提升了检测性能。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对纯相机3D检测因缺乏直接深度测量而精度受限的问题，现有方法多从网络结构入手。② 提出了CoCa3D，一种协同纯相机3D检测方法，通过多智能体通信共享互补信息，并优化通信效率以选择最有信息量的线索。③ 相比已有工作，该方法从多智能体协作的视角提升深度估计，弥补了单智能体视角的遮挡和远距离区域。④ 在DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+和CoPerception-UAVs+数据集上，AP@70分别提升了44.21%、30.60%和12.59%，展示了相机在协同下可超越LiDAR的潜力。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the depth estimation challenge in camera-only 3D detection by introducing multi-agent collaboration. CoCa3D enables agents to share complementary information, improving depth disambiguation and coverage. It achieves significant AP@70 improvements on DAIR-V2X, OPV2V+, and CoPerception-UAVs+ datasets.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种正交的解决方案，通过协同感知显著提升纯相机3D检测性能，具有突破性意义。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出了协同纯相机3D检测框架CoCa3D，通过多智能体通信提升检测精度。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 利用多视角共享信息来消除深度估计歧义并补充遮挡区域。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，AP@70最高提升44.21%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: ① 针对多视角点云配准中初始化和鲁棒性问题。② 提出了基于可靠位姿图初始化和历史重加权的鲁棒配准方法。③ 相比已有工作，改进了初始化和优化策略。④ 摘要未提供具体数据，但方法旨在提升配准精度和鲁棒性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multiview point cloud registration by proposing reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. The method aims to improve registration accuracy and robustness.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 该论文主题与3D感知相关，但摘要信息有限，创新性和影响力需进一步确认。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出了改进的多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 结合位姿图初始化和历史重加权策略。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 旨在提升配准鲁棒性，但未提供具体数据。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: ① 针对视觉中心自动驾驶中联合感知和预测的时序建模问题。② 提出了TBP-Former，学习时序鸟瞰图金字塔，用于联合感知和预测。③ 相比已有工作，该方法通过时序金字塔结构有效捕捉动态信息。④ 摘要未提供具体数据，但旨在提升感知和预测的联合性能。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper addresses joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving by proposing TBP-Former, which learns a temporal bird's-eye-view pyramid. The method enhances temporal modeling for improved performance.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 该论文聚焦BEV时序建模，对自动驾驶感知预测一体化有重要价值。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出了时序BEV金字塔学习框架TBP-Former。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 利用金字塔结构进行时序BEV特征学习。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 旨在提升联合感知和预测性能，但未提供具体数据。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对从多视图进行3D-4D视图合成的问题，提出了一种神经像素合成方法。由于摘要内容缺失，无法详细评估其具体方法、改进点和效果。该方法可能涉及将多视图特征融合以生成新视角图像或3D表示。与现有工作相比，其创新点可能在于像素级别的合成策略。由于缺乏实验数据，无法确认其性能表现。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-views by proposing a neural pixel composition method. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology, improvements, and results cannot be assessed. The approach likely involves fusing multi-view features at the pixel level to generate novel views or 3D representations. Experimental outcomes are unavailable for verification.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，论文的完整性和质量无法评估，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出了一种用于多视图3D-4D合成的神经像素组合方法。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 像素级别的多视图特征合成策略。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对不完整多视图聚类问题，即多视图数据中部分样本缺失，提出了一种跨视图部分样本和原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。现有方法通过跨视图对比学习强制不同视图的表示完全一致，忽略了视图差异，且缺失样本导致聚类原型不对齐和偏差。CPSPAN利用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，引导视图间实例对应关系构建，并进一步处理原型偏移问题。该方法旨在提高不完整多视图聚类的准确性和鲁棒性。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering where samples are partially missing across views, proposing a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN). Existing contrastive methods force identical representations across views, ignoring view discrepancy, and missing samples cause unaligned prototypes. CPSPAN uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and handles prototype shifts to improve clustering accuracy.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 该论文属于多视图聚类领域，与自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低，但方法在数据缺失场景下有一定参考价值。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出了CPSPAN网络，通过跨视图部分样本和原型对齐解决不完整多视图聚类问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 利用代理监督信号进行实例对齐，并处理原型偏移。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称解决了现有方法的缺陷。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对动态场景（如自动驾驶）中多帧深度估计的挑战，即多视图几何一致性在动态区域被破坏导致估计误差。现有方法依赖显式掩码识别动态区域并用单目线索补偿，但掩码质量不可控且融合不充分。作者提出一种新方法，学习融合多视图和单目线索编码的体素，无需启发式掩码。通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块，让静态区域的多视图几何信息传播到动态区域的单目表示，并增强多视图代价体。该方法旨在提高动态场景下深度估计的准确性。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes like autonomous driving, where multi-view geometric consistency is violated. Existing methods use explicit masks and monocular compensation, but suffer from mask quality issues. The authors propose learning to fuse multi-view and monocular cues encoded as volumes without masks, using a cross-cue fusion module to propagate geometric information and enhance representations, improving depth accuracy in dynamic areas.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 该论文直接针对自动驾驶动态场景的深度估计问题，方法新颖且实用，对感知任务有重要参考价值。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需掩码的多视图和单目线索融合方法，用于动态场景多帧深度估计。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 通过跨线索融合模块实现几何信息传播和代价体增强。
2304.08993|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在动态区域有显著改进。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文提出了OmniCity，一个用于城市全面理解的新数据集，包含多级别（卫星、街景全景和单视图）和多视角图像，超过10万张像素级标注图像，来自纽约市2.5万个地理位置。为减少标注成本，作者提出高效标注流程，利用卫星视图现有标签和视图间变换关系。数据集支持建筑足迹提取、高度估计、建筑平面/实例/细粒度分割等任务，并引入街景全景图像上的细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。与现有基准相比，OmniCity图像数量更多、标注类型更丰富、视角更多，并提供了多种SOTA模型基准。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper presents OmniCity, a new dataset for city understanding with multi-level and multi-view images, including over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K locations in NYC. An efficient annotation pipeline leverages satellite labels and view transformations. It supports tasks like building footprint extraction, height estimation, and segmentation, introducing fine-grained building instance segmentation on panoramas. OmniCity offers more images, richer annotations, and more views than existing benchmarks.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 该数据集对多视角城市感知研究具有重要价值，尤其适用于自动驾驶和遥感结合的场景，提供了丰富标注和基准。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建了OmniCity多级别多视角城市理解数据集，并提出了高效标注流程和多种任务基准。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 引入街景全景上的细粒度建筑实例分割新任务，并整合卫星与街景视图。
2208.00928|v2.result: 数据集包含超过10万张标注图像，覆盖2.5万地理位置，提供多种SOTA模型基准。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文提出了一个新的多传感器数据集，用于多视图3D表面重建，包含来自不同分辨率和模态的传感器（智能手机、RealSense、Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪）的配准RGB和深度数据。场景选择强调对现有算法具有挑战性的多种材料属性。数据集包含约140万张图像，覆盖107个不同场景，从100个视角和14种光照条件下采集。该数据集旨在用于3D重建算法的评估和训练。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a new multi-sensor dataset for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, including registered RGB and depth data from various sensors like smartphones, RealSense, Kinect, and industrial cameras. It contains ~1.4 million images of 107 scenes from 100 viewpoints under 14 lighting conditions, designed to challenge algorithms with diverse material properties. The dataset is useful for evaluating and training 3D reconstruction methods.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建研究有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知的关联性有限，主要面向通用重建任务。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 提供了一个大规模多传感器3D重建数据集，覆盖多种传感器和挑战性场景。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 多传感器融合和多样化材料属性设计。
2203.06111|v2.result: 包含约140万图像，107个场景，100视角和14光照条件。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多视图聚类问题，提出了一种全局和跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。现有深度聚类方法通过视图级聚合学习共识表示，忽略了所有样本的结构关系。GCFAggMVC通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，充分探索相似样本的互补性，并使用结构引导的对比学习模块对齐共识表示和视图特定表示。该模块可灵活嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a Global and Cross-view Feature Aggregation network (GCFAggMVC) for multi-view clustering. Existing methods ignore sample structure relationships during view-wise aggregation. GCFAggMVC aggregates features across samples and views to explore complementarity, and uses structure-guided contrastive learning to align consensus and view-specific representations. The module is flexible and can be embedded into incomplete multi-view clustering.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 该论文属于多视图聚类领域，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但方法在特征聚合方面有一定通用性。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出了GCFAggMVC网络，通过全局和跨视图特征聚合改进多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 跨样本和跨视图的特征聚合以及结构引导对比学习。
2305.06799|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称解决了现有方法的局限。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化结合的问题，旨在实现高分辨率新视角合成。②提出了跨视角引导的辐射场优化方法，结合多视角图像超分辨率技术。③相比已有工作，可能改进了辐射场与超分辨率模块的联合优化策略。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses high-resolution novel view synthesis by integrating multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field optimization. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework. Due to missing abstract, specific improvements and results cannot be summarized.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其实际贡献，且与目标研究领域相关性较低。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出跨引导的辐射场与超分辨率联合优化框架。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 跨视角引导机制结合超分辨率与辐射场。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角立体视觉中手部网格重建问题，旨在让网络直接利用3D点特征而非将3D信息编码到2D特征中。②提出了POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上操作，通过点特征融合和跨集点注意力机制重建手部网格。③相比已有工作，创新性地以3D点作为跨视角特征融合的媒介，利用点在不同视图的不同投影来聚合信息。④在三个多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建任务中优于现有最先进方法。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hand mesh reconstruction in multi-view stereo by directly operating on 3D points embedded in the multi-view setting, rather than encoding 3D info into 2D features. POEM uses point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention, outperforming state-of-the-art on three multi-view datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，将3D点作为跨视角融合的天然媒介，在手部重建任务上验证了有效性，对3D感知相关研究有参考价值。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出POEM，一种基于嵌入多视角立体中3D点的手部网格重建方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 利用3D点作为跨视角特征融合的载体，并设计跨集点注意力机制。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视角数据集上优于现有最先进方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角立体匹配中无纹理区域鲁棒性差的问题。②提出了自适应补丁变形方法，以应对无纹理区域的匹配挑战。③相比已有工作，可能通过自适应调整补丁形状来提升匹配精度。④由于摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issue of multi-view stereo on textureless regions by proposing an adaptive patch deformation method. It likely improves matching accuracy by adjusting patch shapes adaptively. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 摘要缺失，但题目针对无纹理区域这一实际痛点，有一定研究意义，但需查看全文评估。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应补丁变形策略以增强无纹理区域的多视角立体匹配。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离导致的误差累积和效率低下问题。②提出ADA-Track，一种端到端框架，通过交替检测与关联（Alternating Detection and Association）机制，在统一网络中联合优化检测和轨迹关联。③相比传统两阶段方法，实现了检测与关联的协同学习，减少了中间表示的信息损失，并支持多相机特征融合。④在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的AMOTA性能，显著提升了跟踪鲁棒性，具体数值需参考论文全文。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and inefficiency in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking caused by separate detection and association stages. It proposes ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework with alternating detection and association to jointly optimize both tasks in a unified network, reducing information loss and enabling multi-camera feature fusion. The method achieves state-of-the-art AMOTA on benchmarks like nuScenes, demonstrating improved tracking robustness.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶多相机感知的核心挑战，提出端到端联合优化方案，具有较高的实用价值和创新性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D跟踪框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 将检测与关联交替优化，实现任务间的协同学习。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: ①针对室内场景多视图图像3D目标检测中，现有方法难以有效聚合多视角信息的问题。②提出CN-RMA，一种结合射线行进聚合（Ray Marching Aggregation）的联合网络，通过沿射线方向聚合多视图特征来增强3D表示。③相比基于体素或投影的方法，RMA更直接地建模了3D空间与2D图像的几何关系，提高了特征利用率。④在室内数据集（如ScanNet）上取得了优于基线方法的检测精度，具体数值需参考论文。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of aggregating multi-view information for 3D indoor object detection from images. It proposes CN-RMA, a combined network with ray marching aggregation that gathers features along rays to enhance 3D representations. Compared to voxel-based or projection methods, RMA models geometry more directly, improving detection accuracy on indoor benchmarks like ScanNet.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 针对室内3D检测的特定问题，方法有新颖性，但领域相关性略低于自动驾驶。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出射线行进聚合模块用于多视图3D室内检测。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 利用射线行进机制实现几何感知的特征聚合。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: ①针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中缺乏标注数据的问题。②提出一种对比预训练方法，利用多视图融合策略学习点云的质量感知表示。③相比传统手工特征或监督方法，通过自监督对比学习充分利用未标注点云，增强了跨视图一致性。④在多个PCQA基准上取得了与监督方法相当或更优的性能，具体数值需参考论文。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of labeled data in no-reference point cloud quality assessment. It proposes a contrastive pre-training method with multi-view fusion to learn quality-aware representations from unlabeled point clouds. Compared to supervised or handcrafted methods, it leverages self-supervised learning for cross-view consistency, achieving comparable or better performance on PCQA benchmarks.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低，但自监督方法有一定参考价值。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出多视图融合的对比预训练框架用于点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将对比学习应用于无参考点云质量任务。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在PCQA基准上达到监督方法水平。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: ①针对帕金森病（PD）的客观评估需求，传统临床评分主观且耗时。②提出TULIP系统，利用多相机3D感知技术精确量化PD患者的运动特征。③相比临床量表或单相机方案，多相机设置提供了更全面的3D运动分析，提高了评估精度。④在PD患者数据集上验证了与临床评分的相关性，具体数值需参考论文。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for objective assessment of Parkinson's disease, where traditional clinical scores are subjective. It proposes TULIP, a multi-camera 3D perception system to precisely quantify motor features of PD patients. Compared to clinical scales or single-camera methods, multi-camera setup enables comprehensive 3D analysis, improving assessment accuracy and correlation with clinical scores.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 应用场景特殊，与自动驾驶研究领域相关性有限，但展示了多相机感知的跨领域潜力。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 将多相机3D感知应用于帕金森病运动评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 跨领域应用多相机感知技术于医疗诊断。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 在PD数据集上验证了评估有效性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人3D姿态估计中依赖大量3D标注的问题。②提出SelfPose3d，一种自监督方法，利用多视角几何一致性约束来训练模型，无需3D关键点标注。③相比监督方法，通过自监督的跨视角重投影和一致性损失，有效利用了多视角数据。④在公开数据集上取得了接近监督方法的性能，显著减少了标注成本，具体数值需参考论文。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance on 3D annotations in multi-view multi-person pose estimation. It proposes SelfPose3d, a self-supervised method that leverages multi-view geometry consistency for training without 3D keypoint labels. Compared to supervised methods, it effectively exploits multi-view data via re-projection and consistency losses, achieving near-supervised performance with reduced annotation cost.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角方法对自动驾驶中3D人体感知有借鉴意义，但非核心方向。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出无3D标注的自监督多视角多人姿态估计框架。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性作为自监督信号。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: ①针对多视图自监督聚类算法在实际场景中因噪声视图导致的性能下降问题。②系统研究了噪声视图对聚类算法的负面影响，并提出缓解策略。③相比现有聚类方法，通过分析噪声来源并设计鲁棒机制，提高了在真实多视图数据上的稳定性。④在多个多视图数据集上验证了改进效果，具体数值需参考论文。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views on self-supervised clustering algorithms in practical multi-view scenarios. It systematically analyzes the negative impacts and proposes mitigation strategies. Compared to existing methods, it enhances robustness to noise, improving clustering stability on real-world multi-view datasets.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，属于通用自监督学习研究。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 揭示并缓解噪声视图对多视图聚类的影响。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出针对噪声视图的鲁棒聚类策略。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在真实数据集上提升了聚类稳定性。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督忽略物体中心深度、远距离物体深度估计困难的问题，提出OPEN检测器，通过物体级深度编码器估计物体深度，并利用物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比现有方法，该方法更符合DETR结构需求，提升远距离检测精度。在nuScenes等数据集上验证了有效性，取得了显著的性能提升。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that pixel-wise depth supervision in multi-view 3D detection ignores object-center depth and struggles with distant objects, this paper proposes OPEN, which estimates object-wise depth via a dedicated encoder and injects it into the transformer decoder using object-wise position embeddings. This approach better aligns with DETR-based detectors and improves accuracy, especially for distant objects, with significant gains on nuScenes.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多视角3D检测的核心痛点提出创新方案，具有较高实用价值，值得关注。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级深度估计与位置嵌入机制，提升多视角3D检测精度。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 将深度监督从像素级提升到物体级，并设计专用位置嵌入。
2407.10753|v2.result: 在标准数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中低分辨率特征表示限制性能的问题，提出从多相机图像学习高分辨率向量表示的方法。该方法通过生成高分辨率特征向量，增强空间细节捕获能力，从而提升检测精度。相比现有基于低分辨率BEV的方法，在复杂场景下表现更优。实验验证了该方法的有效性。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_en: To overcome the limitation of low-resolution feature representations in multi-view 3D detection, this paper proposes learning high-resolution vector representations from multi-camera images. The method enhances spatial detail capture, improving detection accuracy over low-resolution BEV baselines, with experiments confirming its effectiveness.
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.assessment: 该论文探索高分辨率表示，对提升检测性能有积极意义，但细节需进一步验证。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.contribution: 提出高分辨率向量表示学习方法，增强多视角3D检测精度。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.innovation: 利用高分辨率特征向量替代传统低分辨率表示。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.result: 在实验中展示了性能提升。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen._arxiv_id: Learning High-Resolution Vector Representation from Multi-camera Images for 3D Object Detection.

Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中训练样本不平衡和深度感知不足的问题，提出基于深度感知的硬负样本采样方法Ray Denoising。该方法通过射线去噪策略，选择深度困难样本进行训练，增强模型对深度信息的利用。相比随机采样，显著提升检测性能，尤其在远距离目标上。实验验证了方法的有效性。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_en: To address sample imbalance and insufficient depth awareness in multi-view 3D detection, this paper proposes Ray Denoising, a depth-aware hard negative sampling method. By selecting depth-challenging samples via ray-based denoising, it improves depth utilization and detection performance, especially for distant objects, with experiments confirming gains.
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.assessment: 该论文提出新颖的采样策略，针对性强，对实际检测任务有重要改进。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.contribution: 提出深度感知硬负样本采样方法，提升多视角3D检测性能。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.innovation: 利用射线去噪机制选择深度困难样本。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.result: 在标准数据集上取得显著提升。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative._arxiv_id: Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative Sampling for Multi-view 3D Object Detection.

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中嵌入不充分和多视角信息利用不足的问题，提出AEDNet，结合自适应嵌入和多视角感知解纠缠机制。该方法通过自适应特征嵌入和多视角解纠缠，提升点云补全的完整性和细节保留。相比现有方法，在多个基准上取得更优结果。实验验证了方法的有效性。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: To address insufficient embedding and limited multi-view utilization in point cloud completion, this paper proposes AEDNet with adaptive embedding and multiview-aware disentanglement. It enhances completeness and detail preservation, outperforming existing methods on benchmarks, with experiments confirming its effectiveness.
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.assessment: 该论文针对点云补全提出改进，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.contribution: 提出自适应嵌入与多视角解纠缠机制，提升点云补全质量。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.innovation: 结合自适应嵌入和多视角信息解纠缠。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.result: 在多个基准上取得更优性能。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview._arxiv_id: AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion.

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知任务上的不足，提出Blink基准，包含14个经典视觉任务和3807个多选题，涵盖相对深度估计、视觉对应等。人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅达51.26%和45.72%，表明现有模型缺乏感知能力。该基准为改进多模态LLM提供了重要参考。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of core visual perception in multimodal LLMs, this paper introduces Blink, a benchmark with 14 tasks and 3,807 multiple-choice questions. Humans achieve 95.70% accuracy, while GPT-4V and Gemini reach only 51.26% and 45.72%, highlighting significant gaps and providing a roadmap for improvement.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: 该论文提出高价值基准，揭示多模态LLM的感知瓶颈，对领域发展有重要推动作用。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建Blink基准，系统评估多模态LLM的视觉感知能力。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 设计人类易解但LLM难解的感知任务集。
2404.12390|v2.result: 揭示现有模型与人类差距，准确率远低于人类。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: ①针对微小物体异常检测中缺乏多视角和视觉-文本联合标注数据集的问题。②提出了MANTA数据集，包含137.3K张图像、38个类别、5个视角，以及声明性知识和建构性学习两种文本子集，并建立了视觉-文本任务基线。③相比已有异常检测数据集，MANTA首次结合多视角、微小物体和视觉-文本信息，支持更全面的异常理解。④基准实验表明该数据集对现有先进方法具有挑战性，验证了其有效性和难度。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-view and visual-text datasets for tiny object anomaly detection by introducing MANTA, which includes 137.3K images across 38 categories and five viewpoints, along with declarative knowledge and constructivist learning text subsets. It establishes a baseline and benchmarks advanced methods, demonstrating the dataset's challenge and efficacy.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小物体异常检测中多视角与视觉-文本联合研究的空白，对开放集检测和FOD检测有重要参考价值。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角视觉-文本微小物体异常检测数据集及基线。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 创新性地融合多视角图像与分层文本知识用于微小物体异常检测。
2412.04867|v2.result: 基准实验显示现有方法在该数据集上性能受限，凸显其挑战性。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全中解空间大、图像-点云配对数据难以获取的问题。②提出了PCDreamer，利用多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视图，并设计形状融合与整合模块处理多模态输入。③相比传统特征提取和依赖配对图像的方法，PCDreamer无需配对数据，利用扩散先验增强细节恢复。④实验表明在恢复细粒度细节方面性能优越。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: PCDreamer addresses point cloud completion by leveraging multi-view diffusion priors to generate novel views without requiring paired image-point cloud data, followed by shape fusion and consolidation modules. It outperforms existing methods, particularly in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地利用扩散先验解决点云补全中的数据配对难题，对3D重建有启发，但与自动驾驶感知关联度中等。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出无需配对数据、基于多视图扩散先验的点云补全方法。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 利用大型模型中的多视图扩散先验生成形状线索。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在细节恢复上取得优越性能。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从多视图图像重建3D模型时几何伪影和可控性差的问题。②提出了Sharp-It，一个多视图到多视图的扩散模型，通过并行处理多视图集合并共享特征来增强低质量3D对象的几何细节和纹理。③相比直接生成3D表示或从多视图重建的方法，Sharp-It弥合了质量差距，提高了细节丰富度。④实验表明能生成高质量3D模型，减少几何伪影。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: Sharp-It introduces a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that enriches geometric details and textures from low-quality 3D renders, sharing features across views to improve reconstruction quality. It bridges the gap between native 3D generation and multi-view reconstruction methods, yielding high-quality 3D models.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 该方法对3D内容生成有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视图到多视图扩散模型以提升3D重建质量。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 在扩散模型中跨视图共享特征以增强一致性。
2412.02631|v2.result: 生成高质量3D模型，减少几何伪影。

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_cn: ①针对健身场景中多模态、多视角、多人姿态估计缺乏大规模真实世界数据集的问题。②提出了M3GYM数据集，包含多视角视频、IMU等多模态数据，并标注了多人姿态。③相比现有数据集，更贴近真实健身场景，支持多模态融合和多人交互分析。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，主要贡献在于数据资源。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale real-world datasets for multimodal multi-view multi-person pose estimation in fitness scenarios. It introduces M3GYM, a dataset with multimodal data and annotations, offering more realistic settings than existing benchmarks. The main contribution is the dataset resource itself, as no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.assessment: 数据集构建对特定应用有价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低。

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.innovation: 数据集设计结合多模态与多视角，覆盖真实世界健身场景。

Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_cn: ①针对多视角聚类中如何有效利用多模态信息和高阶关系的问题。②提出了Medusa方法，结合多尺度高阶对比学习和双扩散模型进行多视角聚类。③相比传统聚类方法，通过对比学习和扩散模型增强了特征表达和鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_en: This work tackles multi-view clustering by proposing Medusa, which integrates multi-scale high-order contrastive learning with a dual-diffusion model. It improves feature representation and robustness over conventional clustering methods. No quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.assessment: 方法有一定理论创新，但与自动驾驶感知领域相距较远。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.contribution: 提出多尺度高阶对比双扩散模型用于多视角聚类。

MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_cn: ①针对毫米波雷达在长距离、自遮挡场景下的人体行走姿态估计难题。②提出了MVDoppler-Pose方法，融合多模态多视角毫米波传感数据。③相比现有基于视觉或单模态雷达的方法，利用多视角和Doppler信息提升长距离鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数值。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_en: This paper addresses long-distance and self-occluded human pose estimation using mmWave sensing. It proposes MVDoppler-Pose, which fuses multi-modal multi-view mmWave data to improve robustness. The approach leverages Doppler and multi-view cues beyond vision-based methods. No quantitative results are reported.
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.assessment: 毫米波感知对自动驾驶有一定参考，但目标为行人姿态，非核心检测任务。

Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_cn: ①针对多视角聚类中特征增强与融合策略不足的问题。②提出了Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with View Graph方法，先增强特征再渐进融合，并利用视角图结构。③相比现有方法，通过渐进融合和图建模更好地利用视角间关系。④摘要未提供具体数值。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_en: This paper improves multi-view clustering by proposing an enhanced-then-progressive fusion strategy with a view graph. It strengthens features before fusion and models inter-view relationships via graph structure. This differs from existing fusion approaches. No quantitative results are given.

Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.contribution: 提出先增强后渐进融合的视角图聚类方法。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.innovation: 渐进融合与图结构结合，优化多视角信息利用。

GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏多视角视频中多人三维化身重建的几何一致性问题。②提出了GeoAvatar方法，通过几何约束从稀疏视角重建多人化身。③相比现有方法，强调几何一致性，适用于动态多人场景。④摘要未提供具体数值。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_en: This paper tackles geometrically-consistent multi-person avatar reconstruction from sparse multi-view videos. GeoAvatar introduces geometric constraints to improve consistency in dynamic multi-person settings. It advances beyond existing reconstruction methods. No quantitative results are reported.
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.assessment: 三维重建与自动驾驶有间接关联，但主要面向人体化身，非车辆场景。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.contribution: 提出几何一致的多人化身重建方法。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.innovation: 在稀疏视角下引入几何一致性约束。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult._arxiv_id: GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Multi-Person Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Multi-View Videos.

AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_cn: ①针对持续多视角聚类中视角增量变化导致模型退化的问题。②提出了AdaptCMVC方法，通过鲁棒适应机制处理新增视角。③相比静态聚类方法，支持持续学习，避免灾难性遗忘。④摘要未提供具体数值。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_en: This paper addresses continual multi-view clustering under incremental views, where models degrade over time. AdaptCMVC introduces robust adaptation to handle new views while preventing catastrophic forgetting. It extends static clustering to continual settings. No quantitative results are given.
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.assessment: 持续学习思想对自动驾驶在线适应有参考，但聚类任务本身关联度低。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.contribution: 提出适应增量视角的持续多视角聚类方法。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.innovation: 将持续学习引入多视角聚类，处理视角动态变化。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa._arxiv_id: AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incremental Views in Continual Multi-view Clustering.

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸感知任务上缺乏系统性评估的问题。②提出了FaceBench数据集，包含层级化多视角多层级的人脸属性结构（5个视角、最多3层、超过210个属性和700个属性值），并构建了49,919个VQA评估对和23,841个微调对；同时开发了Face-LLaVA基线模型。③相比已有工作，首次提供了细粒度、多层级的人脸属性VQA基准，并配套训练数据。④实验表明现有MLLMs在细粒度人脸属性理解上表现不佳，而Face-LLaVA显著优于它们。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on face perception. It introduces FaceBench, a dataset with hierarchical multi-view multi-level facial attributes (over 210 attributes and 700 values), including 49,919 VQA pairs for evaluation and 23,841 for fine-tuning, along with a Face-LLaVA baseline. Experiments show existing MLLMs struggle with fine-grained facial attributes, while Face-LLaVA significantly outperforms them.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该论文为MLLM人脸感知评估提供了首个系统基准，但与人脸识别或自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，适合关注VLM评估的研究者参考。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 提出了FaceBench数据集和Face-LLaVA基线，填补了MLLM人脸感知评估的空白。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 设计了层级化多视角多层级的人脸属性结构，并构建了大规模VQA基准。
2503.21457|v2.result: Face-LLaVA在细粒度人脸属性理解上显著优于现有MLLMs。

Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_cn: ①该论文针对不完整多视图多标签学习中的表示学习问题。②提出了基于解耦表示和标签语义嵌入的方法，旨在处理视图缺失和标签相关性。③相比已有方法，通过解耦表示分离共享和特有信息，并利用标签语义增强学习。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view multi-label learning by proposing a method based on disentangled representation and label semantic embedding. It aims to handle missing views and label correlations, but the abstract is incomplete, so no specific results are available.
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.assessment: 该论文主题与用户研究领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性低，且摘要不完整，质量评估受限。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.contribution: 提出解耦表示与标签语义嵌入结合的不完整多视图多标签学习方法。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.innovation: 利用解耦表示分离视图共享与特有信息，并嵌入标签语义。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.result: 摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。

Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_cn: ①该论文针对大规模多视图张量聚类问题。②提出了使用隐式线性核的方法，以高效处理高维多视图数据。③相比已有方法，通过隐式核避免了显式特征映射，降低了计算复杂度。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。

Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.innovation: 利用隐式核避免显式特征映射，提升计算效率。

SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多视图表示学习中的融合策略问题。②提出了SeqMvRL，一种顺序融合框架，逐步整合多视图信息。③相比已有并行融合方法，顺序融合能更好地捕捉视图间的互补性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.summary_en: This paper addresses fusion strategies in multi-view representation learning by proposing SeqMvRL, a sequential fusion framework that integrates multi-view information step by step. It aims to capture complementarity better than parallel fusion, but the abstract is incomplete, so no specific results are available.
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.assessment: 该论文主题与用户研究领域相关性低，且摘要不完整，质量评估受限。

Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_cn: ①该论文针对野外场景下可信多视图分类的测试时鲁棒性问题。②提出了增强测试时鲁棒性的方法，以应对分布偏移和噪声。③相比已有方法，专注于测试时适应，无需重新训练。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses testing-time robustness for trusted multi-view classification in the wild. It proposes methods to enhance robustness against distribution shifts and noise, focusing on test-time adaptation without retraining, but the abstract is incomplete, so no specific results are available.

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对生成图像中多视图一致性的评估问题，传统重建指标不适用于生成模型。②提出了MEt3R指标，利用DUSt3R从图像对获得稠密3D重建，用于视图间图像内容扭曲，再比较特征图获得对视角依赖效应不变的相似度分数。③相比已有方法，该指标独立于具体场景和采样过程，可广泛评估多视图生成方法。④实验评估了多种新视角和视频生成方法，包括提出的开放多视图潜扩散模型，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of measuring multi-view consistency in generated images, where traditional reconstruction metrics are unsuitable. It proposes MEt3R, which uses DUSt3R for dense 3D reconstruction from image pairs, warps contents between views, and compares feature maps to obtain a view-invariant similarity score. The metric is scene-independent and evaluated on various generation methods, including a proposed open multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 该论文为多视图生成质量评估提供了新指标，对3D感知和生成模型研究有参考价值，但直接相关性有限。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出了MEt3R指标，用于独立于场景和采样过程的多视图一致性评估。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用DUSt3R稠密重建和特征比较，实现视角无关的一致性度量。
2501.06336|v2.result: 成功评估了多种多视图生成方法，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对机器人操作任务中演示数据收集成本高昂、空间泛化能力受限的问题。②提出了Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口桥接3D可编辑性与2D视觉数据：首先从多视角RGB观测重建度量尺度的3D场景几何，然后在点云上进行深度可靠的3D编辑以生成新的操作轨迹，并几何校正机器人位姿以恢复物理一致的深度，最后利用以深度为主控制信号的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。③相比已有工作，该方法利用3D几何编辑和深度引导的视频生成，减少了重复数据收集，提升了空间泛化能力。④在四个真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，使用生成数据训练的策略在空间泛化方面取得了显著改进，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations for robot manipulation, limiting spatial generalization. It proposes Real2Edit2Real, a framework that reconstructs metric-scale 3D geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing to generate new trajectories, and synthesizes spatially augmented videos via a depth-guided multi-conditional video generation model. Experiments on four real-world tasks show improved spatial generalization for policies trained on generated data, though specific metrics are not reported in the abstract.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该论文将3D编辑与视频生成结合用于机器人演示增强，方法新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，主要面向机器人操作。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出Real2Edit2Real框架，利用3D控制接口和深度引导视频生成来合成空间增强的机器人演示数据。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 以深度为主控制信号的多条件视频生成模型，结合3D几何编辑实现物理一致的演示合成。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上提升了策略的空间泛化能力。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单张图像自监督去噪问题，即仅利用含噪图像本身进行去噪，无需干净图像或大量数据集。②提出了Self2Self方法，结合dropout技术，通过训练一个网络在含噪图像上预测自身，利用dropout的随机性实现自监督学习。③相比已有工作，如Noise2Noise需要成对噪声图像，该方法仅需单张图像，且通过dropout模拟多视角，增强了泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但该方法在单图像去噪领域具有创新性，适用于极端场景。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image self-supervised denoising, proposing Self2Self with dropout to train a network on a single noisy image without clean data. It leverages dropout randomness for self-supervision, improving over methods requiring paired noise, and shows potential for extreme scenarios.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 该论文在单图像去噪领域有独特贡献，但摘要信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出基于dropout的单图像自监督去噪框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout模拟多视角实现自监督。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在单图像去噪任务上实现有效去噪。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对图像级弱监督语义分割中CAM与真实物体掩码之间的差距问题。②提出了自监督等变注意力机制（SEAM），通过一致性正则化约束不同变换图像预测的CAM，并引入像素相关模块（PCM）利用上下文信息细化预测。③相比已有CAM方法，该方法利用等变性作为自监督信号，无需额外标注，且PCM增强了特征一致性。④在PASCAL VOC 2012数据集上，该方法优于现有方法，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但表明性能显著提升。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between CAMs and object masks in weakly supervised semantic segmentation, proposing SEAM with equivariance consistency regularization and a pixel correlation module. It outperforms existing methods on PASCAL VOC 2012, improving CAM consistency without extra labels.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 该论文在弱监督语义分割领域有重要贡献，方法创新性强，但主题与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性一般。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出自监督等变注意力机制提升弱监督分割性能。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 利用等变性约束和像素相关性细化CAM。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上取得领先性能。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督预训练模型在对抗鲁棒性方面未被探索的问题。②提出了将对抗训练引入自监督预训练阶段，生成通用鲁棒预训练模型，并用于下游任务微调。③相比传统端到端对抗训练，该方法在微调时能提升鲁棒性和标准精度，并节省计算成本；同时发现不同预训练任务可集成以增强鲁棒性。④在CIFAR-10数据集上，相比基线，鲁棒精度提升3.83%，标准精度提升1.3%；集成策略进一步使鲁棒精度提升3.59%。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces adversarial training into self-supervised pretraining to create robust pre-trained models, improving downstream fine-tuning robustness and efficiency. On CIFAR-10, it achieves 3.83% higher robust accuracy and 1.3% higher standard accuracy, with ensemble boosting robustness by another 3.59%.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 该论文为自监督学习与对抗鲁棒性结合提供了新视角，对鲁棒感知系统有潜在价值，但直接相关性中等。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次提出自监督对抗预训练框架。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 将对抗训练融入自监督预训练并利用任务集成。
2003.12862|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上显著提升鲁棒精度。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对动作分割中时空变化导致的域差异问题。②提出了自监督时间域适应（SSTDA），包含二元和序列域预测两个辅助任务，联合对齐嵌入局部和全局时间动态的跨域特征空间。③相比其他域适应方法，该方法利用自监督任务更好地捕捉时间动态，减少域差距。④在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast数据集上，SSTDA大幅超越现有最优方法，如F1@25分数从59.6%提升至69.1%（Breakfast），且仅需65%的标注数据即可达到可比性能。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation via self-supervised temporal domain adaptation (SSTDA), using binary and sequential domain prediction tasks. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, e.g., F1@25 from 59.6% to 69.1% on Breakfast, with only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 该论文在视频理解领域有贡献，但主题与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出自监督时间域适应方法用于动作分割。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 联合二元和序列域预测对齐时间动态。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在多个基准上大幅提升性能。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，旨在从部分扫描中预测完整3D场景。②提出了稀疏生成神经网络（SG-NN），利用自监督学习处理稀疏输入数据。③相比已有方法，该方法可能更高效地处理稀疏体素表示，但摘要未提供具体细节。④摘要未给出具体数据，但该方法在3D场景理解中具有应用潜力。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans, proposing sparse generative neural networks (SG-NN) for self-supervised learning. It targets efficient sparse data processing, though details and results are limited in the abstract.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: 该论文与3D感知相关，但摘要信息不足，且与自动驾驶核心领域相关性一般。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出稀疏生成网络用于自监督场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 利用稀疏表示提升效率。

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对从无标注视频中学习可解释关键点的问题，旨在提取语义上有意义的点用于下游任务。②提出了自监督学习方法，利用视频中的时间一致性来发现关键点，并确保其可解释性。③相比已有关键点检测方法，该方法无需人工标注，且通过视频动态增强鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但该方法在视频理解中具有广泛适用性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper focuses on learning interpretable keypoints from unlabelled videos via self-supervision, leveraging temporal consistency. It eliminates manual annotation and improves robustness, with broad applicability in video understanding.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 该论文在自监督视频学习中有价值，但主题与自动驾驶感知相关性中等。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标注视频学习可解释关键点的自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用时间一致性实现无监督关键点发现。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 在视频关键点学习上展示有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督特征学习中，特征泛化能力受限于局部像素统计的问题。②提出了基于图像变换判别的新原则，并设计了一种名为“有限上下文修复”（LCI）的图像变换，该变换仅利用小矩形边界信息修复图像块。③相比已有工作，该原则为选择和设计图像变换提供了明确标准，强调全局统计信息对形状和上下文表征的重要性。④实验表明，该方法能学习到更全局的图像特征，在目标分类和检测等下游任务上具有更好的泛化能力。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of self-supervised features that rely on local pixel statistics. It proposes a principle for discriminating image transformations and introduces a novel transformation, limited context inpainting (LCI), which uses only a small boundary for inpainting. The method improves generalization by capturing global image statistics, benefiting downstream tasks like classification and detection.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 该论文为自监督特征学习提供了理论指导，但实验细节和与最新方法的对比有限，影响力中等。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出了基于变换判别和有限上下文修复的自监督学习原则。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 引入LCI变换并论证其能促进全局特征学习。
2004.02331|v2.result: 在分类和检测任务上展示了更好的泛化性能。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对监督和弱监督3D人体姿态估计中的任务偏差和数据集偏差问题。②提出了一个自监督学习框架，利用基于部件的2D木偶模型、人体姿态约束和未配对的3D姿态，从无标注视频中解耦形状和外观等变化。③相比已有方法，该框架通过可微形式化弥合3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示差距，支持多样相机运动。④定性结果在未见过的野外数据集上展示了超越3D姿态估计和部件分割的泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles task and dataset bias in 3D human pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework that disentangles variations from unlabeled videos using a part-based puppet model and unpaired 3D poses. The differentiable formulation bridges 3D pose and spatial part maps, enabling generalization across diverse camera movements. Qualitative results show superior performance on unseen in-the-wild datasets.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 该论文在人体姿态估计领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督解耦框架用于3D姿态估计。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 利用部件模型和可微表示实现姿态解耦。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在野外数据集上展示了更好的泛化能力。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督密集跟踪性能远低于监督方法的问题。②提出了MAST模型，通过重新评估自监督训练和重建损失的选择，并引入关键的记忆组件来增强架构。③相比已有自监督方法，MAST在基准上显著提升15%，并首次达到与监督方法相当的性能。④在视频目标分割基准上，MAST还提出了新的泛化性指标，显示自监督方法在泛化性上优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap in self-supervised dense tracking by proposing MAST, which reassesses training choices and adds a memory component. MAST surpasses prior self-supervised methods by 15% and achieves performance comparable to supervised methods. A new generalizability metric shows self-supervised approaches are superior in real-world adaptation.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督跟踪领域有显著提升，对视频感知相关研究有参考价值。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 提出了带记忆增强的自监督密集跟踪模型MAST。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 引入记忆组件并优化自监督训练策略。
2002.07793|v2.result: 在基准上提升15%，性能接近监督方法。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督视觉里程计在场景变化时性能下降的问题。②提出了在线元学习算法，利用convLSTM聚合时空信息，并设计在线特征对齐方法以适应新环境。③相比已有自监督VO方法，该方法能持续适应新环境，无需重新训练。④在未见过的户外场景、虚拟到真实和户外到室内等实验中，一致优于最先进的自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of self-supervised visual odometry in novel scenes by proposing an online meta-learning algorithm with convLSTM and feature alignment. The method enables continuous adaptation to new environments. Experiments on unseen outdoor, virtual-to-real, and outdoor-to-indoor scenes show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art self-supervised VO.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶中的视觉定位有实际意义，在线适应能力是亮点。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出了在线适应的自监督视觉里程计方法。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 结合元学习和特征对齐实现环境适应。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在多种场景迁移实验中优于现有方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对草图理解中，现有方法多基于像素和CNN，忽略了草图的矢量序列特性，且SketchRNN学习到的表示主要用于生成而非识别。②提出了Sketch-BERT模型，将BERT泛化到草图领域，设计了新的草图嵌入网络和自监督预训练算法，包括草图格式塔模型（SGM）。③相比已有工作，该方法利用Transformer和自监督学习，更好地捕捉草图的全局结构。④实验表明，Sketch-BERT学习到的表示能提升草图识别和检索等下游任务的性能。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of sketch understanding by proposing Sketch-BERT, which generalizes BERT to vector sketches with novel embedding networks and a Sketch Gestalt Model for self-supervised pre-training. The method captures global sketch structure better than CNN-based and generative approaches. Experiments show improved performance on sketch recognition and retrieval tasks.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 该论文在草图领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的草图自监督表示学习方法。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 将BERT架构和格式塔预训练应用于矢量草图。
2005.09159|v2.result: 在草图下游任务上取得了性能提升。
